  • Have a positive attitude towards change and development. We experience plenty of both, whether we are refining our daily workflows or adapting to the new facilities and working procedures at Hospital City East.
  • Are flexible, constructive and able to maintain an overview and create structure for yourself and your colleagues.
Would You Like to Know More?If you are interested in the position and would like to learn more, please feel free to contact:Lotte JohansenNurse ManagerEmail: lotte.johansen@rn.dkTelephone: +45 41 46 77 51Clinical Unit Coordinators:Mia Nørgaard GranumEmail: mikg@rn.dkSigne MoosEmail: sim@rn.dkTelephone: +45 41 46 79 35For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm – m.cederstroem@rn.dkPractical InformationSalary and employment conditionsSalary and employment conditions will be in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Professionals' Confederation (Sundhedskartellet), negotiated with the Danish Nurses' Organization (Dansk Sygeplejeråd).The position is full-time (37 hours per week). You will have the opportunity to influence your shift schedule so that it can be adapted to your individual needs.Application deadline: 31. December 2026Place of EmploymentYour primary place of employment will be Anaesthesia Unit 1 in Aalborg.Your employment area will cover the North Denmark Region, with your duties based at the Department of Anaesthesia, Aalborg University Hospital.Depending on operational requirements, you may also be required to work in other units within the Department of Anaesthesia in Aalborg, subject to the applicable collective agreement and notice requirements for changes to the duty roster.References will be obtained as part of the recruitment process.About the North Denmark RegionThe North Denmark Region provides public services to approximately 590,000 residents across healthcare, regional development and specialised social services.Around 15,000 employees work together across a wide range of professional disciplines, all contributing every day to improving outcomes for patients and citizens and creating a well-connected North Denmark Region.Working with us offers opportunities to develop your career, make every day meaningful and make a real difference.Find out more about the North Denmark Region at www.rn.dk.

title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description - Restaurant Manager –Indian Dining Experience

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Restaurant Manager to take full ownership of our service. If you have a passion for authentic Indian cuisine and the drive to build a high-performance culture, we will look forward to welcome you to lead our team.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

· Personality & Presence: Outgoing, hardworking, and naturally hospitable. You bring a "service with a smile" mentality and project a welcoming, highly professional presence on the floor.

What We Offer:

· A highly competitive salary.

· A vibrant, fast-paced work environment with a passionate team.

· Opportunities for long-term career growth.

Ready to lead our service?

Please send your CV (including a professional headshot) and a cover letter describing your experience and motivation to info@tandooritwist.dk.

title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

  • Design and implement preventive and systemic interventions at class and year-group levels to promote student wellbeing and positive group dynamics.

  • Develop, implement and review individual student support plans in alignment with the IB Access and Inclusion Policy.

  • Collaborate with the student wellbeing team, student support staff, teachers and parents to coordinate appropriate support.

  • Guide students and families through the Danish public and private healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR, specialist clinics and pathways to diagnostic assessment.

  • Prepare professional referrals and supporting documentation for external assessments, including neuropsychological or psychiatric evaluations, within the scope of professional competence.

  • Follow safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection requirements; identify students requiring specialist intervention and coordinate appropriate follow-up and support.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualifications and training in psychology, counselling or social-emotional support. A qualification as a psychologist, including assessment and diagnosis, is preferred; demonstrated expertise in social-emotional counselling will also be considered.

  • Knowledge of the Danish healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR.

  • Experience with psychological screening and assessment tools such as WISC, WAIS, BASC, and BRIEF is an advantage.

  • Experience working within the International Baccalaureate (IB) system is desirable but not required.

Position Details

  • Reports to: High School Principal / Programme Principal

  • Works closely with: the Learning Support Team, Student Wellbeing Team, teaching staff, parents and external specialists

  • Position: Part-time (50%)

  • Start date: January 2027, or by agreement

  • Closing date for applications: 20 November 2026

title: Qualified Cosmetician
description:

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Working hours: 37 hours per week

Gross monthly salary: DKK 37,200

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 1st of January

About Us

BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier is a professional beauty salon located in Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer a wide range of beauty, skincare and personal care treatments, focusing on quality, professionalism and excellent customer service.

- Perform professional facial and skincare treatments, including skin analysis and consultations.

- Provide waxing, threading and eyebrow-shaping services.

- Assess clients' skincare needs and recommend suitable treatments and products.

- Provide professional consultations and appropriate aftercare advice.

- Maintain high standards of hygiene, sanitation and client safety.

- Manage client appointments, bookings and treatment records.

- Assist with inventory management and daily salon operations.

- Deliver excellent customer service and maintain positive client relationships.

- Work independently and collaborate effectively with other team members.

Qualifications and Experience

We are looking for candidates who have:

- A relevant diploma, certificate or professional qualification in cosmetology, beauty therapy or a related field.

- Practical experience working as a cosmetician, beautician or beauty therapist in a professional salon environment.

- Knowledge and practical skills in facial treatments, waxing, threading, eyebrow and eyelash treatments.

- Understanding of skincare products, treatment procedures and professional hygiene standards.

- Good communication and customer service skills.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- A professional, reliable and client-focused approach.

What We Offer

- A permanent, full-time position of 37 hours per week.

- A gross monthly salary of DKK 37,200.

- A professional, friendly and supportive working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and further training.

- A varied role involving skincare, beauty treatments and client consultations.

- Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish employment standards.

- Other bonuses.

Employment Conditions

The successful candidate will receive a written employment contract specifying salary, working hours, holiday entitlement, notice period and other applicable employment conditions.

The position is based at our salon in Copenhagen and requires physical attendance at the workplace.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

- An updated CV.

- Copies of relevant professional qualifications or certificates.

- A short application describing their professional experience and suitability for the position.

Application email: info@bba-cph.com

Applications will be assessed based on relevant qualifications, professional experience and suitability for the position.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
description:
About ICARS The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. About the role We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. Key responsibilities Website management:
  • Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
  • Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.
  • Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.
Graphic design & visual content:
  • Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.
  • Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.
  • Video editing & multimedia:
  • Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.
  • Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.
Social media support :
  • Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.
  • Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.
Internal communications support:
  • Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.
  • Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.
Press Office and external communications support:
  • Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.
  • Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.
  • Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.
Data and stakeholder information management:
  • Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.
  • Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.
Desired profile We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease. Required qualifications:
  • Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.
  • Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.
  • Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.
  • Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)
  • Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.
What we offer
  • Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.
  • Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.
  • Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.
  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! Terms of employment The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees. The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark. Application and recruitment process Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying. We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026. For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Rethinking Converter Synchronization: 2-Year Postdoctoral Position in Battery Energy Storage Systems
description:
Are you eager to contribute to a bold experimental research project at the forefront of power electronics and energy storage? We are offering an exciting 2-year postdoctoral position for a talented researcher to investigate advanced converter synchronization and control methods for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with particular emphasis on exploiting naturally occurring acoustic and vibration information. The project combines converter control, sensing, signal processing, and experimental validation to explore new approaches toward simpler, more robust, and scalable BESS operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of January 2027, or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the projectThe position is affiliated with the VILLUM Experiment project A-choir and the EMI/EMC In Power Electronics research group at AAU Energy. The project investigates new synchronization concepts for multi-converter BESSs by combining power electronics, sensing, signal processing, and control. A particular focus is placed on whether physical signatures naturally generated during converter operation can provide useful information for synchronization and coordination. 

You will join a research environment working across power electronics, EMI/EMC, converter control, multi-physics analysis, and experimental validation with applications including battery energy storage systems and other converter-dominated energy systems, with opportunities for collaboration across disciplines. The position also offers opportunities for international scientific exchange, participation in leading conferences, and may include research visits to relevant academic or industrial partners.

Your work tasksYou will:

  • Develop and investigate synchronization and coordination methods for power electronic converters.
  • Develop sensing and signal-processing methods for acoustic and vibration measurements.
  • Establish and evaluate relationships between physical signatures and converter switching/operating behaviors.
  • Implement and validate the developed methods using real-time control platforms, HIL, and experimental converter setups.
  • Assess the proposed approaches under representative BESS operating conditions, including robustness to interference and multi-converter interactions.
  • Contribute to the coordination of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision in areas related to your expertise.

Your competenciesWe expect you to have:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in power electronics, power converter modelling and control, converter synchronization, signal processing, EMI/EMC, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and experimental skills using DSP, MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, hardware-in-the-loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as synchronization and coordination control, digital signal processing, time-frequency analysis, data-driven modelling, or machine learning.
  • Good knowledge of battery storage systems or multi-converter systems; experience with synchronization control, hierarchical control, hardware design, or AI-assisted signal would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be an expert in all technical areas covering power electronics, acoustic/vibration sensing, signal processing, or machine learning. Strong competence in power converter control and synchronization, together with solid experimental skills and the ability to work across sensing, EMI/EMC, and system-level interactions, is particularly important. We value scientific independence, critical thinking, strong experimental skills, and a rigorous approach to modelling, implementation, validation, and documentation.

Who we areThe position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based at the Aalborg campus. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

Hooldus-, remondi- ja teenusepakkujate töö koordineerimine ning kvaliteedi kontroll. Regulaarsete objektide ülevaatuste läbiviimine ja probleemidele operatiivsete lahenduste leidmine. Hoone ohutus-, tuleohutus- ja muude kehtivate nõuete täitmise jälgimine.

Tööülesanded: SINU ROLL:• Laste, noorte ja tööealiste kognitiivse ning emotsionaalse seisundi hindamine ja nõustamine tervishoiuteenuse ning eravastuvõtu raames. • Võimalusel ja kokkuleppel ka psühholoogilise nõustamise pakkumine sotsiaalse ja tööalase rehabilitatsiooni raames. • Töö dokumenteerimine vastavalt teenuse osutamise nõuetele.

Omalt poolt pakume: MIDA PAKUME?• Sisukas ja tähenduslik töö – aitad lastel, noortel ja täiskasvanutel paremini toime tulla vaimse tervise väljakutsetega. • Sõbralik, toetav ja kogenud meeskond – oleme avatud koostööle ja üksteise toetamisele, meeskonnasisesed hooajalised üritused ja koos kasvamise võimalused. • Professionaalne toetus ja arenguvõimalused – mentor ja juhendamine sisseelamisperioodil, supervisioonid, koolitused ja kovisioonid, mis aitavad sul oma oskusi täiendada. • Paindlikkus ja tasakaal – pakume osalise koormusega tööd ning võimalust töötada osa ajast kodukontoris. • Konkurentsivõimeline töötasu – hindame sinu panust ja pakume motiveerivat tasustamissüsteemi. • Kaasaegne töökeskkond – meie Tallinna Sütiste keskuses.

Muud nõuded: KEDA OTSIME?• Sul on psühholoogia magistrikraad ja kliinilise psühholoogi kutse (võib olla omandamisel). • Oskad läbi viia kognitiivse ja emotsionaalse seisundi hindamisi ning pakkuda nõustamist. • Suhtud hoolivuse ja empaatiaga erivajadustega inimestesse. • Sul on head analüüsi-, ajaplaneerimise- ja iseseisva töö oskused. • Sul on hea suhtlemise ja meeskonnatööoskus. • Valdad eesti keelt väga heal tasemel nii kõnes kui kirjas. • Oskad kasutada arvutit ja digilahendusi (e-post, dokumendihaldustarkvara). Kasuks tuleb: • Eelnev töökogemus kliinilise psühholoogina. • Pikaajalised erialased väljaõpped (teraapiavaldkonna või eriala spetsiifilised koolitused). • Vene ja/või inglise keeles nõustamise oskus.

title: Vahetusevanem
description:

Varasem klienditeeninduskogemus tuleb kasuks, kuid ei ole kandideerimise eelduseks. Meie jaoks on kõige olulisemad Sinu suhtumine, pealehakkamine ja soov pakkuda külastajatele suurepärast kogemust. description: Ravintola-alan osaaja, etsitkö lisätyötä tai keikkavuoroja? Etsimme innokkaita ravintola-alan osaajia työskentelemään asiakasyrityksissämme Seinäjoen alueella. title: Koulupsykologin virka Perhonjokilaakson alueella
description: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella Soitessa on haettavana KOULUPSYKOLOGIN VIRKA pe 27.11.2026 klo 12.00 mennessäTervetuloa tekemään kanssamme mielenkiintoista ja merkityksellistä psykologin työtä, oppimaan uutta ja kehittymään psykologian alan ammattilaisena!Soiten opiskeluhuollossa työskentelee tällä hetkellä johtavan koulupsykologin ja johtavan koulukuraattorin lisäksi yhdeksän koulupsykologia, 16 koulukuraattoria ja neljä vastaavaa koulukuraattoria. Haemme joukkoomme koulupsykologia Perhonjokilaakson alueelle 1.1.2027 alkaen.Meillä koulupsykologina pääset toteuttamaan monipuolisesti ja luovasti yhteisöllistä ja yksilöllistä opiskeluhuoltoa henkilöstömitoituksen mukaisella oppilasmäärällä (780 oppilasta / koulupsykologi).Tarjoamme sinulle:- työyhteisön ja kokeneiden kollegojen tiiviin tuen- viikoittaiset, saman pöydän ääressä toteutuvat tiimipalaverit- säännöllisen työnohjauksen- tukea kouluttautumiseen- [kilpailukykyisen palkan]- mahdollisuuden tehdä osin etätyötä- mahdollisuuden tehdä osa-aikaista työtä- työn aloitusta tukevan suunnitelmallisen perehdytyksenKoulupsykologin työssä menestymistä edesauttavat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, kyky itsenäiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn sekä kehittävä ja vastuullinen työote. Pätevyysvaatimuksena virkaan on laillistetun psykologin kelpoisuus (272/2005). Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon henkilöstön työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (SOTE-sopimus) mukaisesti. Työaika on 37 h 45 min viikossa.Virkaa haetaan täyttämällä sähköinen hakemus osoitteessa www.soite.fi/tyopaikat . Sähköiseen hakemukseen pyydetään liittämään CV. Sähköisessä haussa ei tarvitse toimittaa jäljennöksiä tutkinto- ja työtodistuksista, mutta ne on varauduttava esittämään mahdollisessa haastattelussa.Ennen viran vastaanottamista hakijan tulee esittää hyvinvointialueen henkilökunnan työterveyslääkärin lausunto työkelpoisuudestaan (sis. huumausainetesti). Lisäksi virkaan valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002). Virassa noudatetaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa.Lisätietoa antaa johtava koulupsykologi Johanna Puumala puh. 040 806 5352 ja toimintayksikön vastaava esihenkilö Maarit Biskop puh. 040 806 5151, s-posti: etunimi.sukunimi(at)soite.fi.Kokkola 11.11.2026Mellersta Österbottens Välfärdsområde Soite ledigförklarar att sökas senast fredag 27.11.2026 kl. 12.00 EN TJÄNST SOM SKOLPSYKOLOGVälkommen att utföra intressant och meningsfullt psykologarbete med oss, lära dig nya saker och utvecklas som yrkesperson inom psykologin!Inom Soites elev- och studerandevård arbetar det för närvarande utöver en ledande skolpsykolog och en ledande skolkurator också nio skolpsykologer, 16 skolkuratorer och fyra ansvariga skolkuratorer. Vi söker en skolpsykolog till vårt team i Perho ådals område med start 1.1.2027.Hos oss får du som skolpsykolog genomföra individuellt och generellt inriktad elevvård mångsidigt och kreativt med det antal elever som är i enlighet med personaldimensioneringen (780 elever/skolpsykolog).Vi erbjuder dig:- nära stöd av arbetsplatsen och erfarna kollegor- veckovisa teammöten vid samma bord- regelbunden arbetshandledning- stöd för utbildning- en konkurrenskraftig lönesättning- möjlighet att delvis arbeta på distans- möjlighet att arbeta deltid- som stöd för inledningen av arbetet erbjuder vi planenlig inskolningGod interaktionsförmåga, förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team samt ett utvecklande och ansvarsfullt arbetssätt är viktiga i genomförandet av arbetet. Behörighetsvillkoret för tjänsten är behörighet som legitimerad psykolog (272/2005). Tjänsteförhållandets villkor och lön fastställs i enlighet med kollektivavtalet för social- och hälsovårdspersonal (SH-avtalet). Arbetstiden är 37 h 45 min. per vecka.Tjänsten söks genom att fylla i en elektronisk ansökning på adressen www.soite.fi/tyopaikat . Vänligen bifoga din CV till din digitala ansökning. Du behöver inte bifoga kopior av examens- och arbetsintyg till din digitala ansökning, men du bör vara beredd på att visa upp dem vid en eventuell intervju.Innan tjänsten tas emot ska den sökande visa upp ett intyg om sin arbetsförmåga utfärdat av en av företagsläkarna för välfärdsområdets personal (inklusive ett narkotikatest). Därtill ska personen som väljs för tjänsten uppvisa ett straffregisterutdrag i enlighet med 6 § mom. 2 i lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002). Vid tillsättandet av tjänsten tillämpas en prövotid på sex månader.Mer information ges av ledande skolpsykolog Johanna Puumala, tfn 040 806 5352 och av verksamhetsenhetens ansvariga chef Maarit Biskop tfn 040 806 5151, e-post: förnamn.efternamn(at)soite.fi.Karleby 11.11.2026

title: Sjukskötare, akutmottagningen
description: Akutmottagningen är den enda öppna jourpunkten 24/7 och vi tar emot ca 10.000 patientbesök per år inom alla akutspecialiteter. Här finns akutsjukvårdens hela spektrum, från det mest grundläggande till det mest avancerade. Vi arbetar i team med akutläkare och akutsjuksköterskor, vilket betyder att som sjukskötare sköter man allt från grundvård till intensivvård. Vi bemannar även hjärtstoppsgruppen som springer på hjärtstoppslarm inom sjukhuset. Arbetet passaar dej som tycker om att arbeta med det akuta omhändertagandet och vill vara med i vårt viktiga teamarbete med patienten i fokus, du stimuleras av tempoväxlingar i arbetet och drivs av att arbeta i en utvecklande miljö. Akuten erbjuder ett arbete som är utmanande, utvecklande och krävande, men samtidigt otroligt roligt och intressant. Vårt mål är att patienten ska känna sej trygg och nöjd efter sitt besök hos oss. Vi söker dej med längre erfarenhet som sjukskötare. Meriterande är erfarenhet av arbete inom akutsjukvård under de senaste åren. Stor vikt sätts på personliga egenskaper, där du som person är självgående och strukturerad. Behörighetskrav för tjänsten är legitimerad sjukskötare (FFS 559/94). Behörigheten ska vara registrerad i Tillstånds- och tillsynsverket för social- och hälsovården.Uppgiften kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med 48 § i Lag om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).Arbetsspråket är svenska.Tjänsten är ordinarie med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Prövotid kan tillämpas.Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25.11.2026 kl 15.00.Vi undanber oss vänligen direktkontakt av bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Network Engineer (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Informatik (Netzwerktechnologie)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description: Ihre Vorteile:- Internationale Projekte in einem sicherheitsrelevanten Umfeld- Moderne Netzwerktechnologien- Langfristige Perspektive in einem abwechslungsreichen ProjektumfeldIhre Aufgaben:- Planung, Konfiguration und Administration komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen- Betrieb und Optimierung von Routing- und Switching-Lösungen- Konfiguration und Management von Firewalls- Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting in produktiven Umgebungen- Unterstützung bei Infrastrukturmigrationen und Rollouts- Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams vor Ort- Erstellung technischer DokumentationenIhre Qualifikationen:- Erfahrung als Network Engineer- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Routing- und Switching-Technologien- Praxiserfahrung mit Enterprise-Firewalls- Idealerweise Zertifizierungen wie CCNA, CCNP oder vergleichbar- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse- Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft- Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü2 vorhanden oder realisierbarÜber Hays:Der Bereich IT ist unsere Kernkompetenz, auf deren Grundlage sich Hays entwickelt hat. Wir beherrschen die komplette IT-Klaviatur von Support bis zur Softwarearchitektur oder Digitalisierung – dank unseres umfangreichen Portfolios ist für jeden etwas dabei. So konnten wir in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten im Rahmen einer Life-Long-Partnerschaft unzählige Fach- und Führungskräfte aus der IT dabei unterstützen, die Weichen für eine erfolgreiche Karriere zu stellen. Unser Beratungsteam ist spezialisiert und somit in der Lage, auf Ihre Wünsche und Vorstellungen einzugehen und Sie auf Bewerbungsgespräche und Vertragsverhandlungen bestens vorzubereiten. Probieren Sie es aus und erfahren Sie, was der Markt Ihnen zu bieten hat – völlig kostenfrei, diskret und unverbindlich! Wir freuen uns auf Sie.

title: UN Human Rights Advocacy
description: (1) conduct interdisciplinary research, collaborate with other NGOs (especially local and national) which share the same mission, and write reports to the relevant UN human rights mechanisms, in order to contribute to the enforcement of the relevant UN conventions surrounding "organized covert torture"as defined in the following report of our NGO to the UN Human Rights Committee:https://tbinternet.ohchr.org/_layouts/15/treatybodyexternal/Download.aspx?symbolno=INT%2FCCP R%2FICS%2FTHA%2F70410&Lang=en(2) present oral statements on organized covert torture at the relevant UN human rights mechanisms;(3) write the application for the UN ECOSOC consultative status by May, 2027; conduct all the required follow-up with the application.(4) reach out to and collaborate with other NGOs with the same or similar missions across the globe, to promote the enforcement of the relevant UN conventions to end organized covert torture in the countries that ratified the said UN conventions, through the criminal prosecution of the perpetrators;(5) engage in (mostly online) media campaign to elucidate the internal mechanism of organized covert torture, structurally caused and undergirded by psychosocial disability discrimination, and to report our NGO's progress at the UN while raising social awareness on this subject.Eligibilities:1. at least a bachelor degree in a relevant field, such as international human rights law, political science and sociology (such as the sociology of law). Interdisciplinary education on human rights is highly appreciated. 2. experiences (at least one year) in advocacy for organized overt torture victims at the UN human rights mechanisms, including writing shadow reports.Please include in the emailed application:1. the URL of your report on organized covert torture on the website of the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights, such as the human rights treaty body database URL that contains the report you drafted on behalf of an NGO.2. the C.V. 3. the digital copy of the diploma.Further informations:The duration of the work contract is 2 years, not permanent.HomeworkAbout the employer:Ending Organized Covert Torture (https://www.uid.admin.ch/Detail.aspx?uid_id=CHE-418.021.541) is a small international human rights NGO (UN Partner ID: 40942; Canadian Corporation number: 1830473-4).

(050) 521 44 11.Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tillsätter tjänster så snart vi hittar lämpliga kandidater. Eila [palkittiin Rekrytoinnin Elämäntyöpalkinnolla](https://www.eilakaisla.fi/blogi/rekrygaala-2025-elamantyopalkinto-eila-kaislalle?hsLang=fi) lokakuussa 2025 postuumisti.Työtä ja elämää, joka on yhteisöllistä ja yksilöllistä. Työtä, josta löytyy iloa ja imua. Tekijänsä näköistä. Työvuoroja on erityisesti iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin, jolloin ravintolamme on parhaimmillaan täynnä elämää.Tule mukaan Rosso Porvoon tarinaan tekemään makumuistoja yhdessä timanttisen tiimin kanssa.Mitä toivomme sinulta?- Kohtaat sekä asiakkaat että työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3- Kokemusta kokin työstä sekä à la carte -annosten, pizzojen valmistuksesta.- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: osaat tarttua tehtäviin ja pidät huolta työpisteestäsi.- Työssä kävellään ja kannetaan paljon, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on eduksi.- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä osana tiimiä.- Suomen kielen taito, jotta pääset helposti mukaan tiimimme arkeen ja yhteiseen tekemiseen.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Työpaikan, johon kiva tulla ja myös kiva lähteä kotiin.- Tiimiä, jossakaveria ei jätetäja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista eli esimerkiksi ruoasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.- MaRa:ntyöehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta joka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 13,32 €/h - 14,62 €/h + työaikalisät- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.- Koko henkilökunnan yhteistä tulospalkkiota, jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti yrityksentuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittarienperusteella.- Kulttuuri- hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.Jätä siis hakemuksesi, jos haluat liittyä joukkoon, jossa laatu, tiimihenki ja asiakaskokemus ovat kaiken tekemisen ytimessä.Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 22.11.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa ravintolapäällikkö Sari Luhanko, sari.luhanko@sok.fi. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.---VI SÖKER EN KOCK TILL ROSSO BORGÅ, 20 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNINGVill du vara med och skapa rätter och restaurangupplevelser som får kunderna att komma tillbaka till oss gång på gång? Vi söker nu en kock för fast anställning till Rosso Borgå.På Rosso Borgå är kvalitet, god mat och varm kundservice hjärtesaker. I vårt team arbetar vi tillsammans, hjälper varandra och tar emot nya kollegor med öppna armar.Rossos mångsidiga meny bjuder på läckra à la carte-rätter, pastarätter och pizzor. Rosso Borgå är också känt för sina smakrika biffar, som under årens lopp har vunnit stor popularitet bland våra kunder. Vi hoppas att du har erfarenhet av att tillreda dessa rätter och är stolt över kvalitativt hantverk.Utöver matlagning hör förberedelser, diskunderhåll och lagerhantering till arbetet. Uppgiften passar dig som trivs i en fartfylld miljö och njuter av restaurangbranschens mångsidiga vardag. Arbetspassen infaller särskilt på kvällar och helger, när vår restaurang är som mest full av liv.Följ med på Rosso Borgås berättelse och skapa smakminnen tillsammans med ett fantastiskt team.Vad önskar vi av dig?- Du möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3- Erfarenhet av arbete som kock samt av tillredning av à la carte-rätter och pizzor.- Ett raskt och initiativrikt arbetssätt: du tar tag i uppgifter och håller ordning på din arbetsstation.- Arbetet innebär mycket gående och bärande, så god fysisk kondition är en fördel.- Vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas som en del av teamet.- Kunskaper i finska, så att du enkelt kommer med i teamets vardag och gemensamma arbete.Vad erbjuder vi dig?- En arbetsplats dit det är roligt att komma och också roligt att gå hem från.- Ett team där ingen lämnas i sticket och där cheferna är med i vardagen.- Rabatter på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, det vill säga till exempel på mat, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.- Lön enligt MaRas kollektivavtal, som beroende på erfarenhetsår är 13,32 €/h – 14,62 €/h + arbetstidstillägg.- 5 % språktillägg om kundservicen fungerar på minst finska och svenska.- En gemensam resultatpremie för hela personalen, upp till 1,70 € / arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmåner.Lämna alltså in din ansökan om du vill ansluta dig till ett gäng där kvalitet, laganda och kundupplevelse är kärnan i allt vi gör.Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 22.11.2026. Närmare information om tjänsten ger restaurangchef Sari Luhanko, sari.luhanko@sok.fi. Arbetet börjar enligt överenskommelse.

description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

title: Vårdare
description: Vi söker en vårdare med närvårdarutbildning till Octavens verksamhetscenter. Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid måndag-fredag.Octavens serviceenhet på Lästmakarvägen 19, är en svenskspråkig enhet som erbjuder dagverksamhet för personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 25 servicetagare i fem basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare som vill bli en del av vårt team på åtta personer.Du kommer i först hand att jobba i en basgrupp som erbjuder sysselsättning i varierande former, men även enskilt med personer inom autismspektrumet. Du bör vara trygg i dig själv och din arbetsroll samt förstå innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. I arbetet ingår också hjälp och stöd i personlig vård. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer så är du den rätta personen för oss. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med engagerade kollegor. Du får ta del av Helsingfors stads mångsidiga utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt personalförmåner som t.ex. kultur- och motionsförmåner, rabatt till kollektivtrafiken och cykelförmån. Närvårdares yrkesutbildning och registrering i Valviras centralregister över yrkesutbildade personer.Goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska samt nöjaktiga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finskaDen sökande ska före antagningsbeslutet förete företagshälsovårdens bedömning om sina förutsättningar att sköta uppgiften.Personen som blir vald till tjänsten måste före arbetsförhållandet börjar presentera arbetsgivaren med ett bevis på drogtest.I uppgiften krävs vaccineringsskydd enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar 48 §, samt utredning över tuberkulos enligt 55§.Den som blir vald till tjänsten bör innan hen tar emot tjänsten, uppvisa ett brottsregisterutdrag för dem som arbetar med personer med funktionsnedsättning (lagen om tillsyn över social- och hälsovårdstjänster 741/2023, 28 §).I uppgiften krävs att LOP/LOVe LOP-läkemedelstillståndet genomförs godkänt inom prövotiden.Vi räknar som en merit:Tidigare arbetserfarenhet inom branschen.Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet i vår arbetsgemenskap. Vi välkomnar sökande av olika åldrar och kön, personer med funktionsnedsättning samt personer som tillhör olika språkliga, kulturella eller eventuellt andra minoriteter. Vi strävar efter att garantera en lättillgänglig rekryteringsprocess för alla sökande. Om du behöver anpassningar eller har önskemål gällande tillgängligheten under ansökningsprocessen, kan du kontakta oss via e-post på: sotepe.monimuotoinen.rekrytointi@hel.fi. Meddelandena hanteras separat från den rekryterande enheten, och kontakten vidarebefordras inte till den rekryterande förpersonen utan den sökandes samtycke.

title: Vårdare
description: Vi söker en vårdare med närvårdarutbildning till Treklangens servicepunkt. Anställningen är tidsbunden för tiden 4.1.2027-20.10.2027 med eventuell förlängning. Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid, i regel måndag-fredag. Arbetsspråket är svenska. Treklangens arbets- och dagverksamhet är en svenspråkig enhet och finns på Kånalavägen i Kånala, Helsingfors. Vi erbjuder arbetsverksamhet samt dagverksamhet för vuxna personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 55 klienter i sex basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare till vårt team inom Stukturverksamheten. Vi söker dig som är pedagogisk, strukturerad och har förmåga att planera och leda en målmedveten verksamhet som engagerar, motiverar och utvecklar klienter. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer inom autismspektrum så är du den rätta personen för oss.Vi söker en arbetstagare som är trygg i sig själv och sin arbetsroll samt vet innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. Inom strukturverksamheten lägger vi mycket fokus på den enskilda individens behov och utvecklar verksamheten utgående från det. Till arbetsuppgifter hör bland annat att planera samt utföra verksamhet, både i individuellt jobb med klienter och grupp samt utveckla meningsfullt innehåll i klienternas vardag på enheten. Hos oss arbetar vi socialpedagogiskt, med fokus på klienternas delaktighet, självbestämmanderätt och valfrihet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som är intresserad av att arbeta med människor med funktionsvariationer och trivs med att jobba med människor. Du är empatisk, har ett gott bemötande och en öppen attityd. Vi värdesätter även ett positivt förhållningssätt och lyhördhet inför klienternas behov. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med engagerade kollegor. Du får ta del av Helsingfors stads mångsidiga utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt personalförmåner som t.ex. kultur- och motionsförmåner, rabatt till kollektivtrafiken och cykelförmån. Behörighetsvillkor: Närvårdares yrkesutbildning och registrering i Valviras centralregister över yrkesutbildade personer.Goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska samt nöjaktiga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finskaDen sökande ska före antagningsbeslutet förete företagshälsovårdens bedömning om sina förutsättningar att sköta uppgiften.Personen som blir vald till tjänsten måste före arbetsförhållandet börjar presentera arbetsgivaren med ett bevis på drogtest.I uppgiften krävs vaccineringsskydd enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar 48 §, samt utredning över tuberkulos enligt 55§.Den som blir vald till tjänsten bör innan hen tar emot tjänsten, uppvisa ett brottsregisterutdrag för dem som arbetar med personer med funktionsnedsättning (lagen om tillsyn över social- och hälsovårdstjänster 741/2023, 28 §).I uppgiften krävs att LOP/LOVe LOP-läkemedelstillståndet genomförs godkänt inom prövotiden.Meriter:-MAPA/AVEKKI utbildning-Nepsy utbildning-Tidigare erfarenhet av att jobba med personer inom autismspektrum
