title: Miljøarbeider 100% fast stilling, Lassa skole
description:
Ønsker du å jobbe sammen med kjekke kolleger og elever, er Lassa den rette arbeidsplassen for deg.Vi har ledig en 100% fast miljøarbeider stilling fra 01.08.26Lassa skole er en barneskole som ligger flott til med Stokkavannet og Mosvannet som sitt nærmiljø. Skolen har ca. 325 elever og 45 ansatte. Vi liker å si at vi drar Lassa raust sammen, noe som betyr at vi ønsker å nå store mål sammen.  Vi bygger det voksne laget gjennom blant annet å finne på ulike sosiale aktiviteter. Det er viktig å være trygge i det voksne miljøet, som rollemodeller og utdannede for den oppvoksende generasjon.Vi er varierte i vår metodebruk og tenker variasjon og mangfold. Å være en aktiv SFO, der elevene medvirker, er viktig for oss.Vi legger stor vekt på at elevene skal få opplæring i sosialt medansvar og medborgerkompetanse. Stavangerskolen mot 2030 er styrende for vårt arbeid, sammen med LK20 og Rammeplanen for SFO.Kvalitet i elevenes hverdag er vårt fokus, og vi er autoritative voksne som er opptatt av relasjonsarbeid.Høres dette interessant ut for deg og vil du vite mer om Lassa skole, ta gjerne kontakt. ArbeidsoppgaverArbeidshverdagen din vil bestå av å jobbe både i skoledelen og på SFO. Du organiser, følger opp og veileder elever og elevgrupper, i lek og organiserte aktiviteter.Du er en fleksibel og aktiv person som kan tar ansvar for egne arbeidsoppgaver.Du er en omsorgs- og ressursperson.Du er en god rollemodell og en tydelig voksen.Du hjelper elevene til å mestre sosiale ferdigheter.Du tar del i daglige gjøremål.Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)Vi søker etter deg som har relevant helse- sosialfaglig bachelor. Gjerne med erfaring fra arbeid knyttet til barn, f.eks fra barnehage og/eller skole/SFO.   Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språknivå tilsvarende B2. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk morsmål.
  • Du er raus, robust, selvstendig, fleksibel og samarbeidsorientert.
  • Du er stabil og har høy moral og arbeidsinnsats.
  • Du er en trygg og tydelig voksen, og en god rollemodell for elever og voksne.
  • Du deltar i personalmiljøet med humor og arbeidsglede.
  • Du er en ansvarlig lagspiller som bidrar til at oppgaver blir utført.
  • Du ønsker å gi barna en kreativ og utviklende hverdag.
Dyktige og engasjerte medarbeider i et godt arbeidsmiljø.Et givende arbeid med elever. Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver.Faglig og personlig utvikling.Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.Hjem/jobb hjem.Stillingskode og lønn etter gjeldene tariffavtale.KontaktinformasjonKatrine Knutsvik ArbeidsstedRektor Berntsens gate 9 4022 Stavanger Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Stavanger kommune Referansenr.: 5208276220 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Startdato: 01.12.2026 Sluttdato: 31.07.2099 Søknadsfrist: 25.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere. Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke.

Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 

Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest: Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Nære relasjoner: For å ivareta tillit, habilitet og en hensiktsmessig organisering av arbeidet, ber vi søkere opplyse om eventuelle nære relasjoner til ansatte eller ledere i virksomheten. Slike forhold kan i enkelte tilfeller få betydning i ansettelsesprosessen.

Vedlegg: Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

title: Ringevikar skole og AKS
description:
Vestli barneskole er en skole i vekst, og vi har per nå ca 650 elever. Vi ligger idyllisk til øverst i Groruddalen med Marka som nærmeste nabo, rett ved Vestli T-banestasjon. Elevene våre speiler verden og her finner du mange ulike språk og kulturer. Det beste med oss er elevene våre og de ansatte som jobber her! De ansatte er meget engasjerte og dedikerte til jobben. Nå ønsker vi å få med oss enda flere på laget!I mars 2021 flyttet vi inn i en nybygd og topp moderne skole. Her trives vi veldig godt! Bygget legger til rette for læring på mange ulike arenaer. Vi har en avdeling for kunst & håndverk, naturfagsrom, stort kjøkken og flerbrukshall. Vi har dyktige faglærere i alle praktisk-estetiske fag. Skolens satsningsområder er lesing og regning som grunnleggende ferdigheter i alle fag og sosial kompetanse. Skolen har et Mestringsteam bestående av en spesialpedagosik koordinator, sosialpedagogisk koordinator og en miljøterapeut. Deres viktigste arbeid er å jobbe for et godt psykososialt miljø ved skolen. Skolen har en spesialpedagog på hvert trinn, og disse er organisert i et eget spes.ped.-team. Vi jobber stadig med å videreutvikle laget rundt eleven.AKS (Aktivitetsskolen) har en egen base, i tillegg brukes klasserommene, og det er ca 330 elever som benytter seg av tilbudet. AKS er bygget opp med en AKS-leder og en baseleder på hvert trinn. Baselederne planlegger aktiviteter og dagliglivet i Aktivitetsskolen.Vi har også en byomfattende gruppe for elever innenfor autismespekteret. 

Flere av våre trofaste vikarer har nå flyttet på seg og fått jobber ut fra kompetanse og erfaringer, vi ønsker oss derfor flere dyktige vikarer med på laget. Her er det muligheter for å gå inn som vikar for gitte perioder, både som pedagog og assistent. Vi ønsker gjerne at du har mulighet til å jobbe 3-5 dager i uka. Det er derfor fint om du skriver noe om tilgjengelighet i søknadsteksten din.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Undervise i alle fag på 1. - 7.trinn som lærervikar

Følge opp enkeltelever innenfor autismespekteret som assistent

Bidra til økt læring og trivsel som assistent i klasser og på AKS

Kvalifikasjoner

Du kan gjerne være lærerstudent eller ta annet relevant studie

Erfaring fra arbeid i skole og arbeid med barn og unge

Svært gode norskferdigheter, både muntlig og skriftlig

Gode digitale ferdigheter

Personlige egenskaper

Du er rolig, tålmodig og engasjerende

Du har et positivt elevsyn og er tydelig i voksenrollen

Du er opptatt av å skape gode relasjoner med elevene

Du liker utfordringer og er løsningsorientert

Du kommuniserer godt med voksne og barn

Du evner å omstille deg raskt og tilpasse deg de behov du møter

Personlig egnethet vil bli sterkt vektlagt

Vi tilbyr

En topp moderne skole

De beste elevene

Aktive elever som ønsker å lære

En jobb der du kan utgjøre en stor forskjell i våre elevers liv

Engasjerte og profesjonelle kollegaer i et godt arbeidsmiljø

KontaktinformasjonAnnette Myhren, Assisterende rektor , 47050258, annette.myhren@osloskolen.no Malin Hellesø Knutsen, AKS-leder, 48998782, malin.knutsen@osloskolen.no ArbeidsstedVestlisvingen 184 0969 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune Referansenr.: 5208998348 Stillingsprosent: 70% Tilkalling Startdato: 01.12.2026 Sluttdato: 31.07.2027 Søknadsfrist: 26.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utdanningsetaten i Oslo sørger for at 90 000 elever og lærlinger lærer og trives, utvikler seg faglig og sosialt og får bruke sin nysgjerrighet, sitt engasjement og sin kreativitet. Som en av våre 17 000 ansatte i Norges største kommunale etat får du jobbe med kolleger med bred faglig kompetanse og med hjerte for Osloskolen.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert, til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i tilfelle få varsel om.

Tilsetting i grunnskolen, videregående skole, voksenopplæring, aktivitetsskolen eller for å gi leksehjelp er betinget av at det før tiltredelse fremlegges politiattest i tråd med opplæringsloven § 17-11.

Les mer om Osloskolen på https://www.oslo.kommune.no/skole-og-utdanning/

title: Avlaster
description:
Har du tid og omsorg å gi?

På Røst søker vi etter trygge og omsorgsfulle voksne som ønsker å være avlaster for barn med behov for ekstra støtte og oppfølging.

Som avlaster kan du gi et barn trygghet, gode opplevelser og meningsfulle aktiviteter, samtidig som du gir foreldre og pårørende verdifull tid til hvile og egne gjøremål.

Vi søker deg som kan ta imot et barn i eget hjem, enten enkelte ettermiddager, kvelder, helger eller som døgnavlastning. Oppdraget tilpasses barnets og familiens behov og hva som passer for deg.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som er trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst. Du har tålmodighet og evne til å møte barns ulike behov, og liker å være sammen med barn og bidra til gode aktiviteter og opplevelser. Du må også kunne samarbeide godt med foreldre og ansatte i kommunen.

Det er ikke krav om formell helse- eller sosialfaglig utdanning. Erfaring med barn eller barn med særskilte behov er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Du får nødvendig informasjon og veiledning både før og under oppdraget.

Du må ha fylt 18 år og kunne legge fram gyldig politiattest før oppstart.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr et meningsfullt og givende oppdrag, der du får nødvendig opplæring, veiledning og tett samarbeid med foreldre og kommunens fagpersoner.

Som avlaster i eget hjem får du 4 800 kroner i arbeidstidsgodtgjørelse per døgn ved døgnavlastning, i tillegg til utgiftsdekning. Rapportskriving og deltakelse i samarbeidsmøter lønnes særskilt.

Vi legger til rette for at oppdraget skal passe både deg og familien du skal hjelpe.

Kan dette være noe for deg?

Send oss gjerne en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, hvorfor du ønsker å være avlaster, og hvilken erfaring du har.

Er du usikker på om dette passer for deg? Ring eller send oss en melding, så kan vi fortelle mer om hva det innebærer å være avlaster på Røst.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Røst kommune er en fremtidsrettet og attraktiv arbeidsplass med visjonen "Røst - et hav av muligheter". Vi verdsetter faglig dyktighet, samarbeid og innovasjon, og som arbeidsgiver legger vi stor vekt på trivsel, inkludering og kontinuerlig utvikling for våre ansatte. Her finner du mange karrieremuligheter innen fiske, turisme og stedsuavhengig arbeid i et dynamisk og støttende arbeidsmiljø.

Helt ytterst i Lofoten, ti mil ut i havet fra fastlandet, ligger det unike øysamfunnet Røst. Med underkant av 500 innbyggere bor du side om side med en av Europas største sjøfuglkolonier og en av verdens rikeste fiskebestander. Røst kombinerer et levende fiskeri- og jordbrukssamfunn med en åpen og internasjonal kultur. Her finner du trygge omgivelser for barna, vakre landskap, frisk sjøluft og uendelige horisonter. Med daglige fly- og ferjeforbindelser til Bodø og resten av Lofoten.

title: PhD Fellow in Evolutionary Biochemistry
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

A 4-year PhD position in Evolutionary Biochemistry is available at the Department of Medical Biology, Faculty of Health Sciences, within the Host–Microbe Interaction (HMI) research group. The position is part of the LacZymes project, led by Dr. Christopher Frøhlich.

General information about the position.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Do you hold a Master’s degree in molecular biology (or a related field) and have a strong interest in the molecular mechanisms underlying antibiotic resistance development? Are you motivated to conduct interdisciplinary research at one of the northernmost universities in the world? If so, this PhD position may be of interest to you.

The successful candidate will join a project aiming to uncover the molecular mechanisms of AMR evolution at the enzymatic level. To address this, the project integrates ancestral sequence reconstruction, directed evolution, pre-steady-state and steady-state enzyme kinetics, and X-ray crystallography. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply.

The PhD candidate will report to Dr. Christopher Frøhlich and is expected to contribute actively to the project while developing expertise at the interface of molecular biology, enzymology, and evolutionary biology.

The PhD candidate will work on the following tasks: 

  • Manage their own research project
  • Experimental design and execution
  • Enzyme evolution and selection
  • Enzyme production and purification
  • Biochemical enzyme characterization
  • Structural and functional characterization
  • Writing scientific papers and a PhD thesis
  • Presenting the work in national and international arenas

Personal characteristics:The applicant should be motivated, creative and ambitious, with a strong ability to work problem-solution orientated both in teams and independently. The applicant should be genuinely interested in the field of molecular evolution and AMR as well as scientific dissemination. In the evaluation of which applicant is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience, and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in this position announcement. The appointment is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants and national guidelines for appointment as PhD fellow

Applicants are required to submit a motivation letter describing how the position aligns with their research interests.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Christopher Frøhlich:

  • phone: +47 46 96 87 78
  • email: christopher.frohlich@uit.no
Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree in molecular biology, microbiology, chemistry or equivalent education, with a grade of C or better. Candidates who have not yet completed their Master’s education must submit a written statement from their main supervisor stating the tentative date of their Master’s defence.
  • Experience in at least two of the following areas: molecular cloning, protein expression and purification, biochemical characterization of enzymes (e.g. kinetic investigations), X-ray crystallography
  • Documented oral and written English skills

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.  Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the field of AMR and AMR mechanisms
  • Experience in coding (e.g. Python) and competence with computer-based analytical tools (e.g., Pymol)
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language
  • Experience in writing publications
  • Experience in a biosafety level-2 laboratory environment

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. (The motivation letter will also be considered.) In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • A motivation letter describing how this position aligns with the applicant’s research interests.
  • CV, including a list of publications, if applicable. 
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Two references with contact information

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure.

title: Technical Support & Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Specialist to bridge the gap between our Customer Care and DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot technical issues by connecting the dots between customer reports and multiple systems and forming a clear hypotheses.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications

  • Practical understanding of web applications (SaaS), mobile app sync, and how software runs in production.

  • Comfortable using application telemetry, monitoring, or server logs to validate your hypotheses efficiently without getting lost in the data.

  • Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, with a knack for explaining technical topics simply.

  • Experience from 2nd-line technical support, IT operations, or QA is an advantage.

  • Skilled at taking vague user symptoms, deducing the underlying conditions, and attempting to reproduce or isolate the failure domain systematically without needing direct code access.

  • Candidates must pass a pre-employment background check (bakgrunnssjekk ) and meet the conduct requirements (krav til vandel/politiattest) for aviation background checks (Luftfartstilsynet) and/or customer-mandated security clearances.

Who You Are

  • Curious: You look at a strange error and immediately start asking the right scoping questions: Is it tenant-specific or platform-wide? Is it a data issue, a module edge case, or a sync conflict? You enjoy testing your theories through clean replication, knowing exactly when to resolve it yourself and when to package a well-scoped ticket for escalation.

  • Pedagogical: You enjoy talking to users and teaching others how a system works.

  • Structured: You keep tickets tidy, respect security standards, and follow issues through to resolution.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Debug & Troubleshoot: Analyze customer tickets and server/application logs to pinpoint root causes and resolve issues directly.

  • Ticket Management: Create, triage, document, and resolve support tickets, ensuring clean handoffs to DevOps when code changes are needed.

  • Customer Dialogue: Support Norwegian and international aviation customers via phone, video, and email with a clear, service-minded approach.

  • Customer Training: Run onboarding and training sessions on the Opscom platform once you know the system inside out.

  • Team Relief: Offload routine operational tasks from Support and DevOps, and keep internal guides updated.

Vi tilbyr

  • A key operational role in an international aviation tech company headquartered at Bodø Airport.

  • Thorough product onboarding and close mentorship from experienced DevOps engineers and aviation specialists.

  • Career growth paths toward DevOps, technical customer success, or product management.

  • Competitive salary and a close-knit team environment.

title: PhD Research Fellowship in Circular Battery Strategies
description:
About the position

Center for Research on Digitalization and Sustainability (CREDS), part of Inland School of Business and Social Sciences, University of Inland Norway (INN), invites candidates to apply for a three-year PhD research fellowship. The position is connected to the field of innovation studies with a specific focus on sustainability transitions, circular economy, business model change and value chains related to electric vehicle (EV) batteries in the context of energy storage and mobility. This may include research on the circular resource flows, reuse and recycle strategies, and competing end-of-life pathways for batteries and battery materials. 

Admission to INN's PhD program, Innovation in Services in the Public and Private Sectors (INSEPP), is a condition for employment as a research fellow. The candidate is expected to participate actively in INSEPP’s activities. After commencement, the candidate must apply for admission to the PhD programme within three months. An agreement for admission to the PhD programme must be in place within six months after commencement. 

As a PhD research fellow, you will be an integral part of CREDS and actively contribute to one or both of its research groups. In addition, the candidate will be employed at a department of the Business School. The position preferably commences as soon as possible, and will conclude with the award of the Degree of Doctor upon successfully completing the program. 

The position is based at CREDS in Innlandet Science Park in Kongsvinger. A high degree of on-site presence is expected. 

For further information, please contact: 

  • CREDS Professor Johan Kask, +47 62 43 01 82, johan.kask@inn.no  
  • CREDS Director and Professor Bård Tronvoll, +47 90 78 55 68, bard.tronvoll@inn.no  
  • Head of INSEPP PhD Program Marit Engen, +47 61 28 81 07, marit.engen@inn.no 
About the project

Project overview 

The PhD research fellow will join an international team of researchers at CREDS, Inland School of Business and Social Sciences. We seek a highly motivated candidate to research circular battery strategies and future applications from a business and innovation perspective. CREDS’s overarching academic objective is accelerating research on the transitions enabling sustainable businesses and societies. The primary focus is to understand transitions at the level of ecosystems and markets and at the intersection between digitization and sustainability, for instance linked to new or changed business models, value chains and practices. 

The candidate’s PhD project should address how scarce resources in circular value chains related to energy and mobility are organized and governed across competing end-of-life pathways. Relevant topics include sustainable value creation, reuse and repair strategies, recycling systems, and business models that extend the useful life of batteries and battery materials. The project may examine how such arrangements work in practice, how they develop over time, and how different pathways can be assessed in relation to sustainability, loop extension, efficiency, resilience, and other relevant criteria. It may also focus on market formation, ecosystem dynamics, governance arrangements, power relations, and the role of technology in handling resource tensions across systems, as well as on how firms and other actors develop circular strategies under competing demands, regulatory change, and uncertainty about future resource use. One particularly relevant empirical example is end-of-life EV batteries, where tensions may arise between reusing or repurposing batteries for second-life energy storage and recycling materials back into battery production or other industrial uses. Norway provides a promising context for studying such issues due to its early and extensive adoption of battery-electric vehicles. 

Candidates are encouraged to define their own research design within this theme. This includes developing the specific research questions, theoretical perspective, empirical focus, and methodological approach in dialogue with the supervisory team and the academic environment at CREDS. A broad range of methodological approaches is relevant for the theme, including qualitative case studies, optimization models, system dynamics modelling, and agent-based modelling. Please note that the project may later be modified in accordance with the supervisors’ advice and the academic research agenda of CREDS. The successful candidate will have a primary supervisor among CREDS’ academic staff.

Qualifications
  • The candidate must have a master’s degree and thesis on a relevant topic. Relevant academic backgrounds may include business and management, innovation studies, energy systems, industrial ecology, system dynamics, systems modelling, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies, topic-related forms of engineering, and other related interdisciplinary fields. 
  • The master's degree must normally constitute 120 ECTS credits. INN’s PhD regulations require that the qualifying education includes a master’s thesis of 30 ECTS. As a rule, the average grade at master’s level must be B. 
  • The qualifying degree(s) must be awarded from institutions in Norway, the EU/EEA or Switzerland, or from an international institution accredited by AACSB, AMBA and/or EQUIS. Where applicable, candidates should specify such accreditation in the application.
  • Candidates who have not yet obtained the master’s degree at the time of application may apply. In this case, candidates must have submitted their master’s thesis by the application deadline. Temporary transcripts and the master’s thesis must be submitted with the application. The final diploma must be available by the time of employment. 
  • Candidates with a master’s degree from a university abroad must attach “Recognition of foreign higher education” from NOKUT. Instructions for obtaining this assessment are available from NOKUT, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education/education-from-outside-ofnorway/recognition-of-foreign-higher-education-bachelor-master-and-phd . 
  • Since the project is likely to involve extensive empirical research, dialogue with practitioners, meetings, and field-based data collection involving Norwegian and other Nordic actors, the ability to work effectively in Nordic industry and institutional contexts will be important. Relevant professional experience from industry or other practice-based settings in the Nordics, or in a comparable context, is therefore considered a strong merit. 
  • Oral and written English is required. Applicants from non-English speaking countries must document their English proficiency in accordance with the Supplementary Regulations for Admission to the PhD Programme at INN University. A command of a Scandinavian language is a strong merit. 
  • Expertise in relevant ICT software for research is an advantage. 
  • Research experience acquired after completion of the master’s degree is considered an advantage, but is not required. 
  • The candidate must be able to work independently and purposefully, and engage confidently with external actors to carry out empirical fieldwork. The role also requires the ability to collaborate well on academic research and publishing.

Evaluation of candidates for the position will be based on a total assessment of educational background, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation and other eligibility requirements, as defined in the advertisement. In addition, the following will be emphasized: quality of the project description, documented independent research and development work or experience relevant to the project.

The position and associated tasks must be carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations for government employees, including also the Act on Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology, etc. Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, come into conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to take up the position at University of Inland Norway. Necessary approvals must be maintained throughout the employment relationship.

How to apply

Relevant applications will be considered by an expert committee. The application and all attachments are to be submitted electronically and must include the following: 

  • The applicant must submit a project proposal with a progress plan (in Norwegian or English, 5-7 pages) that explains how the research work will be carried out and addresses academic relevance, challenges and possibilities within the project. The PhD research fellow hired will, in collaboration with a supervisor, prepare a complete project proposal creating the basis for admission to the PhD program. The project proposal plays an important part in evaluating applicants and must show how the project will lead to a successful completion of a doctoral degree within three years. 
  • Application letter 
  • CV (summarizing education, job positions, and academic work) 
  • Other work that is relevant for the application 
  • Certified copies of transcripts and diplomas for the whole bachelor and master’s degree. An English translation of all education documents is required unless the documents are in Norwegian/Scandinavian. 
  • Names and contact information of at least 2 reference persons. 
  • A copy of the master’s thesis (in PDF)

Attachments must be uploaded as separate files. If the attachments exceed 30 MB, they must be compressed prior to upload. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all attachments are uploaded. Documents submitted after expiry of the deadline will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

We offer
  • An academically stimulating and supportive work environment at a developing institution. 
  • Possibility of professional development in an exciting academic research environment. 
  • Position is paid and placed in position code PhD candidate 1017 in the Government Salary Scale. 
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension, with among other things, good pension and insurance schemes.

For more information about INN University as an employer, please see here.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0FVnszhpJYGeneral information

INN believes that there is strength in inclusion and diversity. We desire employees with different competencies, professional combinations, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to an even better way of solving problems. We will facilitate for employees who need assitance to realise their goals. Relevant adaptations can be, for example, technical aids, adapting furniture or adjusting routines, work tasks and working hours.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in the CV or immigrant background, we shall call at least one applicant in each of these categories for an interview. In order to be considered as an applicant in these groups, the applicants must meet certain requirements. You can read more on this here: https://arbeidsgiver.difi.no/positivsaerbehandling.

We encourage applicants to tick in Jobbnorge if they have a disability, a gap in their CV or immigrant background. The ticks in the jobseeker portal form the basis for anonymised statistics that all state-owned enterprises report in their annual reports

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

University of Inland Norway is home to around 15,000 students and 1,450 employees. We have campuses in Lillehammer, Hamar, Elverum, Rena, Evenstad and Blæstad, and offer some courses at Kongsvinger and Tynset.

INN University is known for strong and enduring academic and research environments that will spearhead regionally, nationally and internationally.  

Our vision is "Stronger together - we build the university in an interdisciplinary community, together with the communities and the industries"

title: Ready to Work Hands-On with Technology Around the World?
employer: KONGSBERG DEFENCE & AEROSPACE AS AVD KONGSBERG
description:
Global Test Engineer / Technician – Production test 

We are looking for a technically skilled and independent colleague to support our production sites around the world in testing, test processes, training, and follow-up activities. 

The position involves extensive travel and extended stays at our production sites. The core responsibility is to train and guide local personnel, ensure that testing is carried out in accordance with our procedures, and contribute to consistent, high-quality standards across all locations. 

You will work hands-on with test stations and equipment, provide technical support when issues arise, and ensure that local teams understand both how tests are performed and how the equipment is operated and maintained. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Travel to production sites worldwide and support local teams in performing tests and following established test processes. 
  • Train and guide operators and technical personnel in test methodologies, operation of test stations, equipment, and software. 
  • Ensure that testing is performed in accordance with established procedures, specifications, and quality requirements. 
  • Support the installation, commissioning, and implementation of test equipment and test processes at new and existing production sites. 
  • Troubleshoot, install, verify, and maintain test stations and associated equipment. 
  • Document faults, deviations, and solutions, and follow up on corrective actions. 
  • Collaborate with central engineering teams and technical specialists when issues require specialized expertise. 
  • Prepare and configure PCs, standardized system images, and test software, and assist with basic network troubleshooting. 
  • Develop and improve test instructions, user manuals, and training materials. 
  • Share experiences and lessons learned from production sites with central testing, development, and engineering teams, contributing to more robust and standardized test setups. 

Qualifications and Requirements  

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical education in electrical engineering, automation, electronics, mechatronics, control systems, IT, or a related field. Relevant qualification combined with extensive practical experience in production, testing, technical service, or industrial environments may be considered equivalent to higher education. 
  • Good technical understanding of test equipment and production processes, with a systematic approach to troubleshooting. 
  • Familiarity with PCs, software installation, and standardized system configurations, as well as a basic understanding of networking. 
  • Interest in IT/OT systems and how production IT supports testing and manufacturing operations. 
  • Ability to follow technical procedures and quality requirements. 
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English. English is the primary working language in our global projects. 
  • To be considered for the position, you must be eligible to obtain a security clearance in accordance with the Norwegian Security Act.

Experience in a production environment, technical testing, or working with test equipment is an advantage, as is previous experience in technical training or travel-based technical support roles. 

You do not need to be an IT/OT or networking specialist. What matters most is that you are comfortable with hands-on troubleshooting and enjoy learning new systems and technologies. 

Personal Qualities 

You have strong communication and training skills, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are able to explain technical processes clearly and effectively. You work independently, take initiative, and approach challenges in a calm, solution-oriented, and methodical way, even when working on your own in the field. With a hands-on and practical approach, you enjoy working directly with technical equipment and solving practical technical challenges. You are structured and organized, follow established procedures, and ensure accurate documentation of your work. You are also adaptable and culturally aware, with the ability to build strong working relationships across different cultures, teams, and locations. As the role involves frequent international travel and extended stays at production sites abroad, you must be comfortable with both. 

Location: Kongsberg. The role involves a significant amount of travel.

What We Offer 

This is a varied and hands-on technical role with extensive international exposure, offering the opportunity to work with test equipment, production processes, and technical solutions across multiple countries. You will play a key role in training colleagues and ensuring consistent testing quality across our global production sites, while working closely with production, testing, IT, and engineering teams. The role also offers excellent opportunities for professional development, as well as the chance to influence and improve testing processes and working methods. 

 

About Us 

Division Missiles & Aerostructures is part of Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace. We develop, assemble, test, and deliver advanced missile systems for naval vessels, coastal defense systems, helicopters, and fighter aircraft. 

Increasing activity and international demand are driving significant growth across our missile business and production organization. Expanding production capacity across locations requires us to develop and transfer critical manufacturing expertise effectively and consistently. 

 

Important Information 

Candidates applying for this position will undergo a background check as part of the recruitment process. The outcome will be considered as part of the overall assessment. 

To be considered for the position, you must be eligible to obtain a security clearance in accordance with the Norwegian Security Act. 

Please note that the recruitment process will continue in January.

title: Maskinsjef til Pioneer Knutsen

title: Informasjonssikkerheitsleiar
description:
Kunnskap som formar samfunnet

UiB skal vere blant Europas fremste universitet, internasjonalt kjent for høg kvalitet i forsking og utdanning. Som samfunnsinstitusjon skal vi bidra til ei berekraftig og demokratisk utvikling og vere ein attraktiv og inkluderande studie- og arbeidsplass.

Video: https://youtu.be/M5n6RnScNgAInformasjonssikkerheitsleiar (seniorrådgjevar)

Vær med å sikre framtidas IT-tenester ved Universitetet i Bergen 

Med auka behov for sikre digitale løysingar søkjer UiB ny Informasjonssikkerheitsleiar. Vi ser etter ein person som kan leie gruppa for informasjonssikkerheit og personvern, vere ein ambassadør for informasjonssikkerheit i organisasjonen og bidra til å styrke vår kompetanse på området. UiB har dei siste fire åra gjennomført ei betydeleg styrking av arbeidet med informasjonssikkerheit. Som informasjonssikkerheitsleiar vil du få ei sentral rolle i å vidareføre og vidareutvikle dette arbeidet i takt med endra trusselbilete og aukande krav til digital tryggleik.

Om IT-avdelinga 

IT-avdelinga ved UiB er eit av dei største og fagleg breiaste IT-miljøa på Vestlandet med om lag 135 tilsette, i tillegg til lærlingar og deltidstilsette studentar. Avdelinga leverer eit stort spekter av IT-tenester til forsking, utdanning og formidling. UiB har sentralisert drift og teknisk forvaltning av IT-tenestene i tett samhandling med heile UiBs organisasjon. Vi er ein kunnskapsrik og engasjert avdeling med deltaking i spennande aktivitetar innanfor heile UiB si verksemd og med brei kontakt med universitetets 4000 tilsette og 20 000 studentar. Vi samarbeider tett med dei andre universiteta i Norge. Vi har eit stort mangfald av teknologiar, kompetanse og nasjonalitetar. Sjå meir om IT-avdelinga her.

Arbeidsoppgåver:
  • Leie arbeidet med informasjonssikkerheit inkludert IT-sikkerheit ved UiB og være IT direktørens rådgivar
  • Leie gruppa for informasjonssikkerheit og personvern. Gruppa består av 8 tilsette inkludert leiar
  • Følgje opp informasjonssikkerheit både innan etterleving av relevante lovar, reglar og retningslinjer, beskyttelse av våre system, infrastruktur og data, deteksjon av hendingar og oppfølging av desse, samt beredskaps- og informasjonsarbeid
  • Se til at UiBs arbeid med informasjonssikkerheit er i samsvar med «beste praksis», under dette etterleving av NSMs «Grunnprinsipper for IKT-sikkerhet» og ISO 27001
  • Utarbeide rutinar, reglement og planar og utføre generell sakshandsaming innanfor sikkerheitsområdet
  • Skapa gode haldningar og syta for kompetanseutvikling innanfor IT-sikkerheit ved avdelinga og det resterande UiB

Den som blir tilsett kan få andre arbeidsoppgåver innan avdelinga sine arbeidsområde.

Kvalifikasjonar og eigenskapar:
  • Søkjar må ha mastergrad innan relevant fagområde. Lang og relevant praksis kombinert med relevant etter- og vidareutdanning kan i nokre tilfelle kompensere for kravet om utdanning
  • Relevant erfaring frå leiing eller erfaring frå koordinering av faglege team
  • Kompetanse innanfor informasjonsteknologi og personvern, samt brei kjennskap og forståing til heile fagområdet
  • Kjennskap til lovverk og forskrifter innan informasjonssikkerheit
  • God skriftleg og munnleg framstillings- og kommunikasjonsevne på norsk og engelsk
  • Erfaring med å handsame hendingar innan IT-sikkerheit og å delta i beredskapsarbeid vil vere ein fordel
  • Erfaring frå eller god forståing av universitets og høgskulesektoren vil vere ein fordel
  • Den som blir tilsett må kunne sikkerheitsklarerast på nivå HEMMELIG (sjå nsm.no)

Vi søkjer ein person som er:

  • Serviceinnstilt og opptatt av å finne løysingar 
  • Påliteleg og har integritet med tanke på å handtere fortruleg informasjon 
  • Sjølvstendig, strukturert og med høg arbeidskapasitet og gjennomføringsevne 
  • Nysgjerrig og med evne til å tileigne seg nødvendig kompetanse 
  • Evne til å samarbeide og dele kunnskap
Vi kan tilby:
  • Eit godt og fagleg utfordrande arbeidsmiljø
  • Ein kunnskapsrik og engasjert organisasjon med deltaking i mange spennande aktivitetar og brei kontakt med brukarane ved universitetet
  • Stilling som seniorrådgjevar (kode 1364) i årsløn kr. 850 000  - 1 050 000  i det statlege lønsregulativet, avhengig av tenesteansiennitet og kvalifikasjonar. For særleg kvalifiserte søkjarar kan det vere aktuelt å vurdere høgare løn.
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse
  • Moglegheit for avtale om delvis heimekontor
  • Gode velferdsordningar
Generell informasjon:

Utfyllande opplysningar om stillinga kan ein få ved å vende seg til: seksjonsleiar Jan Kristian Walde Johnsen (jan.johnsen@uib.no, tlf: 91715378), eller IT-direktør Tore Burheim (tore.burheim@uib.no, tlf: 915 83 860).

Mangfald er ein styrke og gjer at vi kan løyse oppgåvene våre endå betre. UiB treng difor kvalifiserte medarbeidarar uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion, livssyn, funksjonsnedsetjing, seksuell orientering, kjønnsidentitet, kjønnsuttrykk og alder.

Opplysningar om søkjaren kan bli gjort offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har oppmoda om ikkje å bli ført på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje blir teke til følgje, skal søkjaren varslast om dette.

Vi oppmodar søkjarar med funksjonsnedsetjing, innvandrarbakgrunn eller hól i CV-en til å søke. Dersom du kryssar av for dette i søknaden kan du bli positivt særbehandla. Vi inviterer alltid minst ein kvalifisert søkjar frå kvar av desse gruppene til intervju. Nærare om tilsettingsprosessen her.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Sentraladministrasjonen gjev råd og bistand til leiing og fakultet ved Universitetet i Bergen. Sentraladministrasjonen er organisert i sju avdelinger. Les meir om IT-avdelinga her.

title: RETAIL SPECIALIST –  HOME APPLIANCES
description:
WorkShop is now looking for a Retail Specialist for our client Samsung within the Home Appliances category, covering the Oslo region as well as the rest of Norway. We are looking for someone with a strong passion for retail, sales and technology, who is highly driven and has a natural ability to inspire, engage and motivate others. You enjoy building long-term relationships and have a genuine interest in Samsung and its innovative product range.

As a Retail Specialist for Samsung, you will be an important brand ambassador, responsible for strengthening Samsung's position among retailers in your assigned district. You will work closely with retail staff through regular store visits, product and sales training sessions, and various sales-driving activities. An important part of your role is to ensure that retail staff have the right knowledge, confidence and tools to present and sell Samsung's Home Appliances products in the best possible way.

You will also be responsible for ensuring that Samsung's products and brand are presented in an attractive and consistent way in stores. This includes making sure that displays and demonstration products are up to date, properly maintained and functioning as intended. Your workplace will vary between different stores and locations, and you will independently plan and manage your daily work in close collaboration with Samsung colleagues and retail staff. In addition to your regular store visits, the role may involve product launches, events, exhibitions and other promotional activities. You will work towards set targets, follow up on your activities and report relevant results and market insights according to established routines.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct regular and planned store visits to retailers within your assigned district

  • Educate, inspire and update retail staff on Samsung's Home Appliances products, product launches and unique selling points (USPs)

  • Plan and deliver product and sales training sessions, both individually and in groups

  • Motivate and support retail staff to actively recommend and sell Samsung products

  • Ensure that Samsung products, displays and demonstration areas are presented to a high standard and follow current guidelines

  • Drive sell-out through sales activities, product demonstrations and promotional initiatives

  • Participate in product launches, events, exhibitions and other marketing activities

  • Gather market insights, monitor competitor activities and identify opportunities for improvement in stores

  • Document and report completed activities and results according to established routines

We believe you are someone who:

  • Have at least two years of experience in retail, field sales or a similar role, preferably within Home Appliances, consumer electronics or a related industry

  • Have a genuine interest in technology and Home Appliances, such as washing machines, refrigerators and other kitchen appliances

  • Are inspiring and have a natural ability to educate, coach and motivate others

  • Have excellent presentation skills and feel comfortable speaking in front of both small and large groups

  • Have a strong sales mindset and understand how to drive sales performance in retail

  • Are self-driven, structured and proactive, with strong organizational and time management skills

  • Are outgoing, service-minded and confident in building strong and long-lasting relationships

  • Are flexible, solution-oriented and enjoy a varied role with a fast-paced working environment

  • Have good administrative skills and are comfortable with reporting and follow-up

  • Have good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

  • Are fluent in Norwegian and English, both verbally and in writing

  • Hold a valid B driving licence

  • Are able to travel and stay away from home multiple days at the time

We offer you an exciting and varied role representing one of the world's leading technology brands, in an international and dynamic working environment. We look forward to hearing from you!

Additional information

Working hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday. Weekend work may occur in connection with events and special activities

Employment: Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period

Location: Oslo area, Norway

Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement

The recruitment process is ongoing, and interviews will be conducted continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your application through the application link. The last day to apply is 2026-11-20.

You will be employed by WorkShop, not by any specific client. Depending on business needs, you may work for different clients throughout your employment with us.

We are WorkShop: the Consumer Experience Agency – a leading retail agency in the Nordics, dedicated to creating and delivering innovative customer experience for the world's biggest brands. We do that by offering a complete portfolio of services including data & insights, concept, field marketing and much more – so that we can be a partner to our clients in every step. Join one of our teams around the globe and explore your potential through unique projects, pop-ups, store concepts or our brand ambassador programs!

Learn more about our company at WorkShop and follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram! 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Workshop is a global retail agency building brands for the here and now. From screens to stores to the people behind your brand, every impression counts.

title: Radiologist position at Skien Hospital in Telemark
description:
Are you an experienced radiologist seeking a new professional challenge in Norway? We are looking for a dedicated radiologist to join the team at Skien Hospital, a part of the Telemark Hospital Trust.

Skien Hospital is the main facility of the Telemark Hospital Trust, serving as the central hospital for Telemark County. The hospital offers a wide range of medical services, including a well-equipped radiology department that provides diagnostic imaging and interventional procedures. The radiology department is known for its collaborative environment and commitment to high-quality patient care.

 

Responsibilities

  • Interpret and report on MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional X-ray examinations.
  • Perform biopsies and interventional radiology procedures.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary meetings and collaborate with other departments.
  • Provide training and supervision to resident doctors.

Qualifications

  • Medical license and radiology specialty certification from an EU/EEA country.
  • Broad experience in diagnostic radiology, including MRI, CT, ultrasound and interventional procedures.
  • Proficient in English and motivated to learn Norwegian. A free language course will be provided.

Personal qualities

  • Passionate about radiology and patient care.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to new environments.
  • High work capacity and dedication to continuous learning.

What Skien Hospital offers

  • A supportive and friendly working environment.
  • A department focused on quality and continuous development.
  • Access to modern medical equipment and facilities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits, including pension and insurance schemes.

Additional benefits from Dignus Medical

  • Free online language course with a private tutor.
  • Assistance with obtaining Norwegian medical authorization and specialist approvals.
  • Relocation support for you and your family, including help with accommodation and travel arrangements.
  • Ongoing career guidance and support throughout the recruitment process.

About Skien

 

Located in the heart of Telemark County, Skien is one of Norway’s oldest cities, with a rich history dating back to the Middle Ages. The city is renowned as the birthplace of playwright Henrik Ibsen and offers a vibrant cultural scene, including theaters, galleries and music festivals. Skien is surrounded by beautiful nature, providing ample opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing and boating. The city has a population of approximately 55,000 and is well-connected, with Oslo just 1.5 hours away by car or train.

 

If radiology is your passion and you’re ready to embark on a new adventure in Norway, we would love to hear from you!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: PhD Candidate in Multi-Robot Informative Planning for Coastal Monitoring
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of ICT and Natural Sciences (IIR) at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) in Ålesund is opening a PhD position in distributed informative planning for teams of autonomous and remotely operated marine vehicles, with applications in coastal environmental monitoring.

Coastal waters and fjords change continuously. Pollutants spread, floating litter drifts with wind and currents, and water quality and biological activity vary across both space and time. A single vehicle can only observe a small part of such an environment at once. Teams of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), supported by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), can cover larger areas, observe processes from several viewpoints at the same time, and respond to what they detect.

To use such teams effectively, the vehicles must build a shared and predictive picture of the environment and decide together where each of them should go next. They must do this under the real constraints of the marine environment, including limited communication, changing weather and heterogeneous vehicles.

The position is part of NTNU Ålesund’s work on ocean intelligence: collecting data about the ocean to support use cases such as monitoring of fish spawning grounds, mapping of microplastics and suspended contamination and water quality monitoring. 

The position builds on ongoing research at the department on autonomous surface vehicles, informative path planning, online mapping of spatial fields and tracking of drifting targets, which has been validated in field trials. The PhD project will extend these methods from single vehicles to cooperating teams of heterogeneous vehicles.

The research will combine theory, simulation and field experiments. Field work will be carried out in coastal waters near Ålesund with the department's fleet of USVs and UAVs.

The successful candidate will contribute to one or more of the following areas:

  • Multi-robot coordination for monitoring spatially and temporally varying phenomena, such as drifting objects, pollutant plumes and evolving environmental fields, including distributed informative path and trajectory planning.
  • Mobile robot sensing, mapping and active decision making for heterogeneous teams of USVs and UAVs, using methods such as model predictive control, sampling-based planning, probabilistic mapping and machine learning, under limited and intermittent communication.
  • Implementation on real vehicles and validation in field experiments, including remote operation and supervision of the team

Within the scope of the project, the PhD research can be adapted to the candidate's interests and background, with emphasis on planning and control, estimation and mapping, or learning-based methods.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral training programme and successfully obtain a PhD degree.
  • Conduct high-quality research within the framework described above.
  • Develop, implement and test algorithms in simulation and on real vehicles.
  • Plan and take part in field experiments with teams of USVs and UAVs.
  • Contribute to academic publications and engage in popular science dissemination.
  • Actively participate in the research group Cyber-Physical Systems Laboratory (CPS Lab).
  • Engage in international academic activities, including conferences and/or research stays at partner institutions abroad.
  • Take courses in relevant technical topics, comprising a minimum of 30 ECTS.
Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in engineering cybernetics, robotics, control engineering, marine technology, mechatronics or a closely related field. Candidates with strong backgrounds in computer science, applied mathematics or data science combined with relevant experience in robotics, optimization or machine learning will also be considered. 
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must have good programming skills, for example in Python or C++.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's doctoral programme in Engineering Cybernetics.
  • Applicants from non-English speaking countries outside Europe must present an official language test report. The acceptable tests are TOEFL, IELTS, and Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE).
  • Minimum scores are:
    • TOEFL: 600 / writing 4.5 (paper-based) or 92 / writing 22 (internet-based)
    • IELTS: 6.5, with no section lower than 5.5 (only Academic IELTS test accepted)
    • CAE/CPE: grade B or A. 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with multi-agent or multi-robot systems, distributed optimization or distributed estimation
  • Experience with informative path planning, model predictive control or sampling-based planning
  • Experience with Gaussian processes or other probabilistic mapping methods
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2, robotics simulators such as Gazebo, or GPU-accelerated computing
  • Experience with field work, marine vehicles or drones
  • Drone pilot certificate (EU A1/A3 or A2) and/or boat driving license for Norway
  • Demonstrated research ability, e.g. through publications, thesis work, technical reports or open-source contributions.
  • Relevant industry or applied research experience.

The research activity may lead to using sensitive information or insights into critical infrastructure that is subject to specific security restrictions. Restrictions could also include obtaining a formal security clearance according to the Norwegian Security Act. Non-Norwegian citizens can be granted clearance. However, candidates from non-EEA or non-NATO countries can not expect to obtain a security clearance.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

  • Work independently and in a structured way, as well as collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team
  • Communicate effectively and present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed 

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of up to 12 months additional employment related to career-enhancing activities.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Cybernetics within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work.
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees. 

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Erlend Magnus Lervik Coates (erlend.coates@ntnu.no). 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Silje Storbråten Kjersem (silje.s.kjersem@ntnu.no).

title: Sales development Rep
description:
We are looking for a motivated full-time sales professional to join our commercial team. In this role, you will work with the CamReach platform, run outbound campaigns, follow up with prospects by phone, and support the development of our commercial pipeline.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role with a strong focus on outbound calling, but you will not be working alone. You will have a support structure around you with pre-sales research, target selection, prospect data, campaign messaging, and the CamReach platform helping you prepare for and follow up each conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound cold calls to selected Nordic SMB prospects based on structured pre-sales research and qualification

  • Follow up on prospects already engaged through CamReach campaigns across email and LinkedIn

  • Work from prepared target lists, company research, contact data, campaign messaging, and call support provided by the wider sales operation

  • Use the CamReach platform to understand prospect activity, engagement, and relevant context before and after calls

  • Qualify interest, identify sales opportunities, and move relevant prospects into the next stage of the sales process

  • Maintain accurate CRM and campaign records, including call outcomes, follow-up actions, and prospect feedback

  • Work closely with the sales team to continuously improve targeting, messaging, call scripts, and campaign performance

Mindset & Work Style

  • Self-managed and target-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your own activity and results

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes continue to evolve

  • Confident speaking with new prospects and starting commercial conversations

  • Professional and comfortable using LinkedIn as part of the sales process

  • Commercially minded and interested in understanding how different businesses sell and acquire customers

  • Willing to learn, test different approaches, and use feedback to improve

Skills

  • Fluency in Norwegian or one of the Scandinavian languages is a must

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • Ability to independently research, understand, and qualify prospects

  • Ability to communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different companies and decision-makers

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, sales platforms, and digital tools

  • Confident handling objections and progressing conversations towards a meeting or next step

  • Ability to make cold calls

Experience

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar commercial role

  • Experience with outbound calling and prospecting

  • Experience with cold outreach across channels such as phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • A track record of working towards activity, pipeline, or sales targets

Perks and benefits

  • Full-time position

  • Flexible working hours

  • Remote work allowed with prior coordination

  • Office location near public transport

  • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage technology company and take on increasing responsibility as the team expands

Working at CamReach AS

CamReach is a B2B sales platform built around three core capabilities: Discover. Qualify. Engage.

The platform helps companies identify the right prospects, qualify which opportunities are worth pursuing, and engage them through coordinated outreach across channels such as email and LinkedIn. The aim is to give sales teams a more structured and effective way to build pipeline, with better data, better preparation, and more relevant outreach.

CamReach comes from a strong software development and technology background. The platform has been developed by a team of experienced developers, data analysts, and data scientists with deep experience in building digital products, data-driven systems, and business applications.

The wider team combines this technical capability with senior commercial and executive experience across technology, international business development, sales, and company building. This means we approach the product from both sides: how the technology should work, and how it needs to perform in a real commercial environment.

We are an early-stage Norwegian technology company with paying customers and an active commercial pipeline. We also have an ambitious product and growth roadmap ahead of us, with plans to expand both the capabilities of the platform and the markets we serve.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at an early stage, grow with the team, take on increasing responsibility, and be part of building the commercial side of a technology company with significant ambitions for the years ahead.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CamReach is a B2B outbound sales platform built for Nordic and European SMBs. We help sales teams find the right prospects, run multichannel outreach across email and LinkedIn, and book more meetings, without adding headcount or relying on expensive agencies. The platform is built around a simple idea: precision beats volume. Instead of blasting thousands of generic messages, CamReach helps companies identify the right targets, craft relevant outreach, and learn from every campaign to get sharper over time. We are an early-stage Norwegian startup with paying customers, an active pipeline, and a team that moves fast. GDPR compliance is built into the core of what we do, which matters increasingly for companies selling into European markets. We are now expanding our go-to-market engine and looking for driven people to join the team.

Vakre Sveio ligg midt i storregionen mellom Boknafjorden og Bjørnafjorden.Dei vel 5.750 sveibuane har kort veg til alle servicefunksjonar og tilgjenge til ein stor og variert arbeidsmarknad på Haugalandet og i Sunnhordland.
