title: Rektor till Fröafallsskolan
description: På Fröafallsskolan väntar ett viktigt och utvecklande uppdrag där pedagogiskt ledarskap, trygghet och elevernas måluppfyllelse står i centrum. Med ett tillitsfullt och tydligt ledarskap får rektor möjlighet att tillsammans med medarbetare och biträdande rektor forma en skola där alla elever kan och vill lyckas.Här finns möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad – varje dag.ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom rektor leder, samordnar och utvecklar du det pedagogiska arbetet i verksamheten. I nära samarbete med biträdande rektor ansvarar rektor för skolenhetens organisation, resursfördelning och systematiska kvalitetsarbete.Ett centralt uppdrag är att skapa en verksamhet där elevhälsa, elevinflytande och föräldramedverkan blir en naturlig del av skolans utveckling. Det innebär också att hantera konkreta dagliga verksamhetsfrågor samt att leda och koordinera arbetet med schemaläggning, resurshantering och organisering av undervisningen.Med ett helhetsperspektiv blir sambanden mellan organisation, undervisning och resursanvändning tydliga – och därmed också möjligheterna att stärka elevernas måluppfyllelse. Ett tillitsbaserat ledarskap är en viktig grund för att tillsammans utveckla skolenheten mot ökade resultat inom kunskap, trygghet och hälsa.Samverkan är en självklar del av uppdraget. Det sker inom förvaltningen, tillsammans med kollegor på andra skolenheter och vid behov med andra förvaltningar – alltid med barnets bästa i fokus.Som arbetsgivarföreträdare har rektor ansvar för medarbetare, budget och arbetsmiljö. Tillsammans med biträdande rektor skapas förutsättningar för en skola där alla kan och vill vara.Närmaste chef är verksamhetschef för grundskola och rektor ingår i grundskolans ledningsgrupp för rektorer.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som har pedagogisk högskoleutbildning och arbetsrelaterad erfarenhet av chefs- eller ledarskap samt av att leda systematiskt kvalitetsarbete. God kännedom om läroplaner, skollag och andra styrdokument är en förutsättning, liksom god administrativ förmåga.Utbildning inom chefskap och ledarskap är meriterande. Även erfarenhet av att leda utvecklingsarbete inom grundskolans lägre åldrar och fritidshem är meriterande.För rollen är följande önskvärda egenskaper:    Ledarskap: Du får människor att växa och ta ansvar genom att kombinera tydliga förväntningar med tillit och handlingsutrymme. Du motiverar, involverar och skapar energi kring en gemensam riktning. Med ett närvarande ledarskap driver du verksamheten framåt och får medarbetare att vilja bidra till utvecklingen.    Pedagogisk insikt: Du har en god förståelse för hur människor lär och för vad som främjar elevernas kunskapsmässiga och sociala utveckling. Du kan se olika behov och förutsättningar och väger in det pedagogiska perspektivet när du prioriterar, organiserar och fattar beslut.    Kommunikativ: Du uttrycker dig klart och tryggt och anpassar din kommunikation efter situation och mottagare. Du gör komplexa frågor begripliga, lyssnar in olika perspektiv och skapar förståelse för beslut och förändringar. Du känner dig bekväm med att tala inför grupper och kan förmedla både riktning och engagemang.    Relationsskapande och samarbetsorienterad: Du bygger förtroende genom att vara lyhörd, prestigelös och genuint intresserad av människor. Du möter elever, medarbetare och vårdnadshavare med respekt och har lätt för att skapa goda samarbeten även när perspektiven skiljer sig åt. Du ser värdet av olika kompetenser och får människor att känna att deras erfarenheter och bidrag spelar roll.    Problemlösande analysförmåga: Du är nyfiken på vad som ligger bakom en utmaning och söker förståelse innan du agerar. Du kan sortera stora mängder information, se samband och identifiera vad som är viktigast att ta tag i. Därefter omsätter du analysen i genomförbara lösningar och följer upp att de ger önskad effekt.    Beslutsam: Du har mod att fatta beslut även när situationen är komplex och alla fakta inte är tillgängliga. Du kan prioritera, väga konsekvenser och agera med gott omdöme när flera behov konkurrerar om uppmärksamheten. I ditt beslutsfattande håller du fast vid uppdraget, elevernas bästa och verksamhetens långsiktiga mål.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.OM ARBETSPLATSENFröafallsskolan är en F-6-skola belägen mitt i Fröafalls- och Toståsområdet. Med cirka 320 elever erbjuder skolan en trygg och naturnära miljö med säker skolväg.På Fröafallsskolan finns grundskola, fritidshem samt en resursskola för årskurs 1–6. Det skapar en varierad verksamhet med goda möjligheter till samarbete, lärande och utveckling utifrån elevernas olika behov.ANSTÄLLNINGTillsvidareanställning, 100 %.Tillträde efter överenskommelse.LÖN OCH FÖRMÅNERI Tranås kommun tillämpar vi individuell lönesättning.Tranås kommun arbetar ständigt för att öka våra medarbetares välbefinnande. Läs mer om våra förmåner på vår hemsida tranas.se.ANSÖKANFör att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Tranås kommun använder vi rekryteringsverktyget Talent Recruiter. Ansökan skickas därför via Talent Recruiter genom ansökningslänken i annonsen.För intresseanmälan och konfidentiell förstakontakt är du välkommen att kontakta HR-konsult Hanna Gustavsson via mail: mailto:hanna.gustavsson@tranas.seIntervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan och möjligheten att vara med och utveckla Fröafallsskolans fortsatta arbete!

title: Ekonom till företag i Halmstad
description: Är du ekonom som trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och eget ansvar? Vill du kombinera löpande redovisning och lönehantering med ett intresse för digitala arbetssätt? Då kan detta vara en tjänst för dig!Om tjänstenSom ekonom hos vår kund i Halmstad blir du en del av ett litet ekonomiteam där du avlastar och stöttar i det dagliga ekonomiarbetet. Du arbetar med löpande redovisning, leverantörs- och kundreskontra, månadsavstämningar och krediteringar. I rollen ingår även lönehantering och arbeta med bokslut.Du fungerar som backup för kollegor inom ekonomifunktionen och kan även stötta i budgetarbete och HR-relaterade frågor. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med övriga teamet och delaktighet i arbetet med att utveckla rutiner och arbetssätt. Du rapporterar till ekonomichef. Vår kund är ett medelstort, stabilt och familjärt företag med kontor i Halmstad. Rollen innebär arbete på plats på kontorstid. Flextid, friskvårdsbidrag och god arbetsmiljö ingår i rollen. Om digVi söker dig som har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi från universitet eller yrkesutbildning samt har minst två års erfarenhet ifrån en ekonomifunktion. Du är van vid att arbeta i Excel och har god systemvana. Erfarenhet av Monitor är meriterande men inget krav.Som person tar du ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och trivs med att samarbeta och stötta kollegor. Du har ett intresse för digitala arbetssätt och är nyfiken på hur AI kan användas i ekonomiarbetet.Anställningsform/omfattning/tjänstgöringsortTjänsten är en direktrekrytering till vår kund, på heltid med provanställning på 6 månader därefter tillsvidareanställning. Placering är i Halmstad. Tillträde i januari 2027. Urval sker löpande tillsättning kan ske innan ansökningstiden löpt ut. Har du frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringskonsult Hanna Bonli Comnell på 0736 84 77 73. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Energiexpert till Energitjänster (vikariat)
description: Vill du vara med och att skapa Sveriges mest hållbara kretsloppsstad och samtidigt hjälpa våra kunder att använda energi smartare?Nu söker vi en engagerad medarbetare till gruppen Energitjänster inom Försäljningsavdelningen. Tjänsten passar dig som har ett intresse för energi, teknik och hållbar utveckling.Du kommer att ingå i ett team med bred kompetens där vi tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla, optimera och underhålla energilösningar för våra kunder.Om ossGruppen Energitjänster arbetar med att optimera kundernas energianläggningar, genomföra energitjänster, driva projekt och ombyggnationer samt hantera underhåll av fjärrvärmeanläggningar och mätare.Vi är idag elva medarbetare med olika kompetenser och erfarenheter som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor samtidigt som du bidrar till våra kunders energiomställning.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom energiexpert blir du en viktig del i arbetet med att utveckla och optimera energilösningar för våra kunder. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.Som ett led i vårt säkerhetsarbete genomför vi bakgrundskontroller samt alkohol- och drogtester på kandidater som är aktuella för anställning.Kontakt Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Andreas Carlsson, Energitjänstchef på 0768-61 77 28Vår vision är att tillsammans med boråsarna skapa Sveriges mest hållbara kretsloppsstad. Borås Energi och Miljö ansvarar för infrastruktur i Borås såsom fjärrvärme, avfallshantering, vatten och avlopp. Vi är över 380 medarbetare och omsätter cirka 1,3 miljarder. description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. title: Research assistant on vegetation-atmosphere interactions
description: Department of Soil and EnvironmentA 2-month research assistant position is available in the Soil and Environmental Physics group at the Department of Soil and Environment, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), in Uppsala. We are looking for a researcher with interest in vegetation-atmosphere interactions, in particular using eddy-covariance data. We offer a stimulating research environment with opportunities to collaborate with soil scientists and ecologists, within SLU, in Sweden and internationally).About the positionAs a research assistant in the project, you will be expected to drive independent research, including data collection from online databases and statistical data analyses, writing scientific papers in collaboration with the project group and external collaborators, and presenting research results at seminars and conferences.Your profileWe are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher with excellent skills and experience in collection, harmonization, and statistical analysis of eddy covariance data on carbon fluxes. We are particularly interested in candidates able to link eddy covariance data to remote sensing products.Given the nature of the research project, we expect the selected candidate to be able to interact with soil scientists, ecologists, and biogeochemists. Experience in publishing in highly ranked scientific journals in English is also important.About usThe Department of Soil and Environment is a leading soil research institution, both nationally and internationally. Our research focuses on fundamental soil properties and processes, as well as how soil functions are affected by changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decision-making in agriculture, forestry and the urban environment. The working environment at the department is international and we have around 100 employees.Our research is carried out in seven subject groups with a focus on Soil Biology, Soil Nutrient Cycling, Soil Chemistry, Agricultural Water Management, Soil and Environmental Physics, Soil Mechanics and Soil Management, and the Biogeochemistry of Forest Soils. We are responsible for important research infrastructure in the form of soil chemistry and soil physics laboratories, an X-ray scanner, long-term field experiments, a lysimeter facility, and the field research stations at Lanna and Lövsta. The Department participates in approximately 30 courses at undergraduate and advanced level.We are a part of the Soil, Water and Environment Center at SLU (MVM-center), which provides links to research on water systems, recycling and bioenergy. Our work is aligned to national environmental and climate goals as well as to the Sustainable Development Goals. We are situated at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and in Skara. title: PhD student in biomass resources from sustainable cropping systems
description: Department of Biosystems and Technology PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/ About the positionTargeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases. The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency. All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline. Your profileWe are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability. Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:    agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;    systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;    modelling or scenario analysis;    bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;    nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;    crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;    statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables The project strives to provide knowledge for several societal sectors (bioenergy, food production, environmental impact), it is therefore important to have an ability to understand and integrate information from different scientific fields. The successful candidate should have good analytical skills, be able to work independently and systematically, and at the same time enjoy collaboration in an interdisciplinary research environment. Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement. Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process. About usInformation about the department: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/biosystems-technology/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/ Form of employment / FundingEmployment as a doctoral student (4-year programme). Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Location:Alnarp, Sweden Scope:100% Start date:Upon agreement. Preferably in January/February 2027. Application and selection:Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

title: PhD student in agricultural bioeconomy systems
description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyPhD project: Sustainable utilisation of agricultural green biomass in integrated protein and biogas systemsSubject area: TechnologyDescription of the doctoral project A circular and fossil-independent bioeconomy requires renewable biomass without increasing competition for agricultural land and food production. Crop residues and intermediate crops are therefore particularly relevant resources. Research at SLU shows that these biomass resources can be substantial, but their potential and sustainable utilisation vary regionally. They can be used for biogas, while effects on soil carbon and nutrient cycling need to be considered.  Green biomass can also be biorefined into plant protein for feed or food, after which the remaining streams are used for biogas. The same feedstock can thereby provide protein, energy and recycled nutrients.The project aims to assess the potential and consequences of large-scale utilisation of green crop residues and intermediate crops in integrated biogas and green biorefinery systems.The project will:    assess sustainably available biomass from green crop residues and intermediate crops in Sweden;    assess the potential for biogas and combined plant protein and biogas production;    develop implementation scenarios based on feedstock availability, infrastructure, logistics and markets;    assess effects on nutrient cycling, soil carbon, biomethane, fertilizer use, and feed and food production; and    evaluate economic and wider socio-economic benefits, drawbacks and trade-offs.The project combines GIS and agricultural data with mass and nutrient balances, scenario modelling, and life cycle-based, techno-economic and socio-economic methods. Data will be drawn from research, statistics, literature and national databases.The doctoral student will join an interdisciplinary research environment at SLU Alnarp focusing on sustainable agricultural production, bioenergy, circular bioeconomy and systems analysis.About the positionThe work includes collection and processing of agricultural and process data, GIS, modelling of biomass and product flows, scenario development, and environmental and economic assessments.  You will integrate information from crop production and biomass availability to biorefineries, biogas, and food and energy systems.  You will analyse data, develop models and scenarios, and publish and present research results. The work will be conducted with researchers at SLU and external partners.  The doctoral student will be part of the Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC), a national transdisciplinary centre where Linköping University, SLU and around 50 private and public organisations collaborate. The centre is supported by the Swedish Energy Agency. The PhD project follows BSRC’s research plans and contributes to long-term competence development in industry and academia.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in technology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.  You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.You should have a Master’s degree or equivalent in, for example, biosystems/agricultural engineering, environmental engineering, agricultural science, energy systems, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field.Your profileWe are looking for a motivated candidate interested in sustainable agricultural and bioeconomy systems and quantitative analysis.Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is desirable:    systems analysis, modelling or scenario analysis;    GIS and spatial analysis;    life cycle assessment, environmental systems analysis or material-flow analysis;    techno-economic or socio-economic assessment;    bioenergy, biogas or biorefinery systems;    agricultural production systems and agricultural biomass;    statistical analysis and handling of larger datasets;    experience of programming or quantitative modelling, for example using Python, R or MATLAB.You should have good analytical skills, be able to integrate information from different fields, work independently and collaborate well.Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not required.Personal qualities, motivation and the ability to successfully complete doctoral studies will be given considerable weight. About usThe Department of Biosystems and Technology develops knowledge for sustainable and resource-efficient agriculture, horticulture and bioeconomy through research combining biological production systems, technology and systems analysis. The project lies at the intersection of agriculture, biosystems engineering, sustainability assessment and bioeconomy. Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/Form of employment / FundingEmployment as a doctoral student (4-year programme) Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.Location:Alnarp, SwedenScope:100%Start date:Upon agreement. A start date in January or February 2027 is preferred. Application and selection: Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

We will provide training to suitable candidates.Personal QualitiesWe are looking for someone who is:    Service-minded: Passionate about creating excellent guest experiences.    Responsible: Reliable, punctual, and committed to quality.    Team-oriented: Cooperative, respectful, and supportive.    Efficient: Able to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards.    Adaptable: Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.    Motivated: Interested in learning, improving, and growing with Omami. What We Offer    An opportunity to join a growing Asian Street Food restaurant concept.    A friendly, inclusive, and multicultural working environment.    On-the-job training and professional development.    Opportunities for career progression within the Omami organisation.    A dynamic workplace where teamwork, initiative, and performance are valued.    Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish employment regulations. How to ApplyIf you are passionate about food, enjoy working with people, and want to be part of an ambitious restaurant team, we would love to hear from you!Please submit your CV and a short introduction about yourself, mentioning your relevant experience, availability, and why you would like to work at Omami.Application Email: HR@omamigroup.seApplication Deadline: 20 November 2026Work Location: Gothenburg Central StationJoin Omami Central AB and be part of our journey to bring exciting Asian Street Food experiences to more guests!OMAMI – Asian Street Food | Great Food. Great People. Great Experience.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description: Job DescriptionIKEA Range & Supply has the responsibility to develop, design, produce and supply IKEA stores with home furnishing solutions available to the many people. Each year IKEA Range & Supply introduce 2,000 new products in the IKEA stores. The total range is almost 10,000 products.Älmhult is home to IKEA of Sweden. Here the IKEA range is developed and made available to stores and customers all over the world. At IKEA of Sweden, you will work in a truly international and dynamic environment. You will have different opportunities to learn new skills and where the goal always is to create a better everyday life for the many people.Hej, my name is Monika. Right now, I´m looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to the Accounting department in Älmhult.We offer a challenging and inspiring role where you will have the possibility to be a part of a great team working together to support the business in the best possible way. You will together with the team and our stakeholders continuously work to improve our processes, to gain efficiency and to achieve excellence in our operations. Are you ready to grow with us? Keep on reading!The accounting department at IKEA of Sweden support several Inter IKEA companies both within and outside Sweden with Accounting services. You will be a part of the team that provide support related to the Accounts Payable (AP) process and responsible for that all invoices processed in a proper and timely way, according to global or local guidelines and routines. As Accounts Payable Specialist you work close to the other team members, and your main tasks and responsibilities are to give timely and clear support related to the Accounts Payable (AP) process. Ensure that all invoices are coded with correct accounting string (all elements), VAT code and processed according to PoA (Power of Attorney) for the Inter IKEA Company; maintain the supplier master data and users of the AP invoice handling system; participate in monthly closings of the AP system and the accruals of invoices; provide support connected to the accounts payable processes to co-workers within Inter IKEA companies and to external suppliers.You will also be responsible for loading supplier payment proposals in a timely and accurate way; actively participate in the work to increase efficiency and quality; participate in creating/maintaining manuals, guides, and routines to help others in the team and to improve the processes.To be successful in this role you need to be curious and open to new ways of working and strive to improve processes. Accurate, analytical, and have attention to details. Service minded and communicated in a clear and simple way.  We want you to be structured and could prioritize completing your tasks efficiently. We believe that you have working experience within Swedish Accounting- and VAT legislation connected with the Account Payables processes. You need to have good knowledge in Swedish and English, both writing and speech. Knowledge in Microsoft office, Excel, and experience from working with financial systems is also needed for the role.You can have a bachelor’s degree in business administration or YH-education in Accounting, but equivalent working experience is also fine.The IKEA values motivates you and creating a better everyday life for the many people who guide you in your work.Additional InformationDoes this sound interesting to you?Please send your application, CV latest by November 15 2026. Instead of a motivational letter, we would like you to answer the questions below.    What do you believe is your contribution to this position?      What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply?If you have any questions about the role please contact the Finance Operations Manager, Monika Friberg via monika.friberg1@inter.ikea.com or People & Culture Recruiter, Christina Appelqvist via +46-766-113408

title: Head of Business Unit Procurement
description: Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.Your RoleAs Head of BU Procurement, you will serve as Procurement's senior strategic representative towards one of Saab Surveillance's Business Units. Acting as a trusted partner to Business Unit leadership and Product Owners, you will ensure Procurement plays an active role in business planning, governance, and decision-making while providing an independent supply chain and commercial perspective. You will translate business strategies, customer commitments, product roadmaps, and future needs into Procurement priorities and contribute to strategic discussions around industrial footprint, make-or-buy decisions, outsourcing, and long-term supply chain development. You will also ensure market developments, sourcing opportunities, risks, and commercial considerations are taken into account.A key part of the role is leading and developing a team of Procurement Product Leaders and driving effective collaboration across products, projects, and business opportunities. Working closely with Category Management, Strategic and Operative Purchasing, and other Procurement functions, you will ensure alignment, prioritization, and successful execution across the organization.This is a unique opportunity to strengthen Procurement's position as a strategic business partner and influence how supply chains, sourcing strategies, and Procurement capabilities contribute to future business success. As our Business Units go through a period of unprecedented growth, Procurement's ability to ensure our supply chain and suppliers can respond will be critical to meet future growth plans. As Head of Business Unit Procurement you will be instrumental in translating business needs into stable supply chains, working together with the Procurement teams and our Suppliers. You will join a collaborative and business-focused Procurement organization where your leadership will have a direct impact on both customer success and long-term growth.Key Responsibilities:    Act as Procurement's senior strategic representative towards the assigned Business Unit.    Translate business strategies, growth plans, customer commitments, and product requirements into Procurement priorities and action plans.    Provide a long-term supply chain perspective to strengthen competitiveness, resilience, and delivery capability.    Identify and communicate supply chain risks and opportunities while promoting initiatives that improve competitiveness, resilience, and sustainability.    Lead, develop, and support a team of Procurement Product Leaders.    As a member of Surveillance Procurement leadership team, contribute to the overall leadership and development of the Procurement function    Foster a collaborative, high-performing culture and consistent ways of working across products, projects, and programs.    Support strategic decision-making and ensure alignment between Procurement capabilities and future business requirements.Your ProfileYou are a strategic and commercially minded leader who enjoys working closely with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions that shape future business success. You understand complex business needs and can translate them into clear Procurement priorities while creating alignment across organizational boundaries.You build trust, challenge constructively, and balance strategic thinking with a strong understanding of operational realities. As a leader, you create direction, develop people, and establish the conditions for both team and business success.We believe you have:    Significant experience within Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Category Management, Project Management, or a related field.    Senior leadership experience with responsibility for developing individuals and teams.    Strong business and commercial acumen.    Experience in sourcing, supplier management, supply chains, risk management, project management, and business planning.    Experience working with customer projects, product portfolios, business opportunities, or complex delivery commitments.    A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic decision-making.    Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.    Experience from manufacturing, industrial, aerospace, defence, or other complex technology environments is highly beneficial.This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.What You Will Be a Part OfExplore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

title: IT Sourcing Lead
description: Company DescriptionAFRY provides services in engineering, design, digitalization, and advisory. We are dedicated experts in industry, energy, and infrastructure, creating value for future generations. With Nordic roots and a global reach, AFRY combines local expertise with international capabilities. Our shared values and ways of working: Result Driven, Client Centric, Empowering, and Accountable – guide how we collaborate, grow, and succeed together. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable society.Job DescriptionDo you want to help shape how AFRY works with sourcing, vendor management and strategic technology partnerships in an increasingly digital world? AFRY is looking for an experienced and driven IT Sourcing Lead to help evolve our sourcing and vendor management capabilities across a global organization. In this role, you will work at the intersection of business, technology and commercial management, ensuring that sourcing decisions, supplier relationships and partner ecosystems support AFRY's strategic priorities, digital ambitions and long-term business goals. You will collaborate closely with IT leadership, business stakeholders and key suppliers, driving initiatives that strengthen performance, improve cost efficiency and maximize value from our technology investments. The position is located at our Solna office, with the possibility to combine office and remote work.What you will doAs IT Sourcing Lead, you will play a key role in developing and continuously improving how AFRY works with sourcing, commercial management and strategic technology partners.Your responsibilities will include:    Evolve AFRY's sourcing and vendor management practices, governance and operating model.    Lead sourcing initiatives and supplier selection processes.    Drive commercial negotiations, contract renewals and supplier discussions.    Manage relationships with key technology and service providers.    Establish performance management and follow-up models for strategic suppliers.    Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, service quality and business value.    Create transparency around supplier performance, commercial outcomes and spend.    Support digital and transformation initiatives through effective sourcing and partner management.    Ensure sourcing decisions and supplier agreements appropriately address information security, data privacy, intellectual property rights and responsible use of data and AI-enabled technologies.    Evaluate commercial, pricing and contractual models to balance business value, cost efficiency and risk.    Advise stakeholders on sourcing-related opportunities, risks and decisions.QualificationsWho you are:You are a commercially minded and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and driving tangible business outcomes. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are comfortable working across organizational boundaries, influencing stakeholders and leading initiatives from idea to execution.You likely have experience within one or more of the following areas:    IT sourcing    Vendor management    Technology strategy    Management consulting    Procurement or commercial management    Digital transformationWhat you bring:    Experience in sourcing, vendor management or commercial management within a complex organization.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Experience leading commercial discussions and supplier negotiations.    Ability to translate complex insights into clear recommendations and actions.    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluency in English. Swedish is considered an advantage.    The ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.Additional InformationThis is an opportunity to play a central role in the continued development of AFRY's sourcing and vendor management capabilities. You will work across a global organization, engage with senior stakeholders and contribute to how AFRY leverages technology partners and external expertise to support growth, innovation and business performance. This is a permanent position. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process for the selected candidate.Welcome to submit your application no later than: 13/11-2026. For questions regarding the position, please contact:Anders Nääs, Head of CIO Officeanders.naas@afry.com (mailto:anders.naas@afry.com)For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact:Sofia Enander, Talent Acquisition Partnersofia.enander@afry.com (mailto:sofia.enander@afry.com)As part of all recruitment processes at AFRY, we conduct identity verification, reference checks and verification of educational qualifications.At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Lead software engineer
description: Job Description    Significant experience as a Senior Software Engineer, Software Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent role in complex embedded software or automotive platform development.    Strong experience with embedded software architecture, complex ECU platforms, software integration, and cross-functional engineering environments.    Strong AUTOSAR competence, particularly AUTOSAR Classic Platform architecture and concepts, including software components, Basic Software (BSW), and the Runtime Environment (RTE).    Practical experience with AUTOSAR configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and interaction between application software and platform services is highly desirable.    Understanding of multi-ECU architectures and software-defined vehicle concepts, including interface management and platform-level dependencies.    Experience with architecture and design governance, technical decision-making, risk management, and systematic root-cause analysis.    Good understanding of automotive software development processes, engineering quality practices, continuous integration, and delivery toolchains.    Working knowledge of C/C++; scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages is beneficial.    Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams and coordinating technical topics across organizational boundaries.    Strong communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.    Fluent English, both written and spoken. Relevant Tools and Technologies    Software and scripting: C/C++, Python, Bash, YAML.    Version control and code review: Git, Gerrit.    CI/CD and automation: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Zuul, Cynosure, Ansible.    Verification and integration: CANoe and related integration/debugging tools.    Build and deployment ecosystem: Artifactory, Docker.    Monitoring and reporting: Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and related dashboards.    Collaboration and lifecycle tools: Jira, Confluence, and applicable requirements/engineering tools.    Engineering frameworks and processes: applicable platform development, engineering, and quality standards.Job Responsibilities    Provide technical leadership and day-to-day technical coordination across platform workstreams.    Maintain architectural alignment and consistency across software components, interfaces, integrations, and releases.    Contribute to platform architecture, design reviews, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards; document recommendations and decisions.    Provide technical guidance on embedded software, ECU/platform integration, software component design, and system-level dependencies.    Apply AUTOSAR architectural principles and support alignment between software architecture, platform configuration, and integration needs.    Coordinate technical dependencies and interfaces between development, integration, verification, quality, and other relevant engineering teams.    Identify, assess, and manage technical risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; escalate critical topics with clear impact analysis and proposed options.    Lead or coordinate technical investigations, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex platform issues.    Promote software quality, maintainability, reuse, robustness, and integration efficiency throughout the development lifecycle.    Support integration planning, technical readiness reviews, release preparation, and resolution of issues affecting delivery milestones.    Encourage continuous improvement in engineering practices, automation, development workflows, and technical governance.    Ensure technical documentation is accurate, accessible, and maintained, and support knowledge transfer across teams.    Provide clear technical status, risks, decisions, and recommendations to program and engineering stakeholders. Department/Project DescriptionThe Platform Technical Lead is responsible for overall technical coordination, architectural alignment, and technical quality across platform maintenance and development activities. The role ensures that technical decisions, designs, interfaces, and implementation approaches remain consistent with agreed platform architecture, engineering standards, and delivery objectives. The Technical Lead works closely with platform stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams, provides technical direction, and supports the progressive transfer of platform knowledge and ownership.

title: Dossäljare Kalmarsund
description: Växa är ett ledande kunskapsföretag för lantbrukare med mjölk-, köttproduktion och växtodling. Genom den rådgivning och service vi säljer bidrar vi med ökad konkurrenskraft för svenskt lantbruk. Vår omsättning är drygt 560 miljoner kronor och vi har cirka 500 medarbetare fördelade på 27 driftsplatser över hela landet. Hållbarhet är centralt för oss, och våra kunder och Växa står för klimatsmart produktion och god djurhälsa. Hos Växa får du utveckling - bra förmåner och engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad för våra kunder och medlemmar, och det märks!About the WorkplaceVäxa is a leading knowledge-based company serving farmers within dairy, meat production, and crop cultivation. Through the advisory services and support we provide, we contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture. Our annual turnover exceeds SEK 560 million, and we employ approximately 500 people across 27 operational locations throughout the country. Sustainability is central to our mission, and together with our customers, Växa promotes climate‑smart production and high standards of animal health.At Växa, you will find opportunities for development, attractive benefits, and dedicated colleagues. Together, we make a meaningful difference for our customers and members — and it truly shows.1 plats(er). Dossäljare till KalmarsundAvelsavdelningen i Växa Sverige söker dig som brinner för kor och avel. Vi säljer Viking Genetics avelsmaterial till lantbrukare och har kontor över hela Sverige. Just nu har vi en tjänst ledig i Kalmarsund. Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med försäljning och leverans av vårt avelsmaterial. Du kommer köra vår distributionsbil och leverera doser till kunder i området. Dina arbetsuppgifter innebär att du i tätt samarbete med kollegor i avelsteamet servar våra kunder på bästa sätt.Tillsammans med Växa Sveriges övriga personal såsom husdjurstekniker, avelsrådgivare, djurhälsoveterinärer, företagsrådgivare, bygg- och växtodlingsrådgivare bildar vi team runt våra kunder för att utveckla deras företag.Vi söker dig som     Har stort intresse för lantbruk och mjölkproduktion.     Gillar att möta och kommunicera med människor    Är duktig på att planera och hålla ordning.    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, tal och skrift    Har giltigt B-körkort  Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga drivkraft och söker personer med stort engagemang och förmåga att möta människor. Du har ett lokalt team att luta dig mot men vi förväntar oss att du tar egna initiativ, har ett sinne för ordning och reda och kan arbeta självständigt. Det är ett extra plus om du har    Arbetat som säljare     Praktisk erfarenhet från mjölkproduktionVi erbjuderEn spännande tjänst på heltid eller enligt överenskommelse, med placering på vår driftsplats Kalmarsund som ligger i Färjestaden, Öland. En tillsvidareanställning med lön enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten kommer att kräva en del nätter på hotell.Möjlighet att arbeta i ett dynamiskt team där vi tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontaktaRegionchef Avel Öst Julia Nilseryd Tfn: 072-224 48 49 Julia.Nilseryd@vxa.seFacklig kontakt: Unionen: Patrik Davidsson, tfn: 073-096 36 12 mejl: Patrik.Davidsson@vxa.seAnsökan senast 2026-12-31Skicka in din ansökan omgående (rekryteringen startar nu). Urval kommer ske löpande. Tillträde efter överenskommelse.Skicka in din ansökan nu. Vi kommer börja intervjua omgående. Sista ansökningsdag är den 31 december 2026. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
description: OverviewMicrosoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Operations Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.Responsibilities    Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations    Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services      Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters      Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency      Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year     Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives      Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring      Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners    Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio  Qualifications Required Qualifications:    Proven experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure).    Strong people management experience, including hiring, mentoring and team development    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.    *This role requires you to be on-site, and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised.Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:     Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:    Relevant experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND xperience working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $500k+    Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field.    Experience in leading a diverse, technical team.    Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP, CDCP.    Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services     Experience working on large scale CE projects      Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.) Data Center Operations Management M4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 684,000.00 - kr 1,140,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.Find additional benefits and pay information here:https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.htmlThis position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Senior Product Manager - Stockholm or Hudiksvall
description: Want to tackle complex customer problems, shape product strategy, and turn insight into measurable impact? Come and join us as a Senior Product Manager.About the RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines strategic thinking with hands-on product leadership. You’ll shape the vision and strategy for your product area and turn customer insights into measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll lead your Product Trio and the work of your empowered cross-functional team through expertise, influence, and collaboration, without formal people-management responsibilities.What You’ll DoProduct Leadership    Set the vision and strategy for your product area.    Lead discovery and delivery with your Product Trio and cross functional team.    Use customer insights and data to define impactful solutions.    Set success metrics and ensure measurable outcomes.    Align stakeholders across commercial, technical, and customer-facing teams.    Lead through influence and champion modern product practices.You’ll often lead your team remotely rather than work together in person day to day, making strong communication and trust-building essential.Who You AreTo succeed in this role, you bring strategic thinking, strong collaboration skills, and a natural drive to move things forward. We place more weight on your personal qualities than on having the “perfect” resume.You are:    A strong collaborator who builds trust and brings people together.    Confident in making decisions, even in complex situations.    Proactive and self‑driven, with a strong sense of ownership.    Strategic, analytical, and able to prioritise what matters most.    Goal- and results-oriented with the energy to drive progress.    A supportive, inclusive leader who develops and coaches others.    Guided by integrity and empathy, fostering a positive and safe environment.What You BringWe believe the right mindset and personal qualities matter most. But to thrive, you likely have:    Experience as a Product Manager working with modern product development.    Curiosity and drive. You make things happen rather than wait for direction.    Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is an advantage.    Experience with SaaS, the Product Operating Model, or Agile frameworks is a plus.    Experience working with AI coding assistants and context repositories is a plus.Who We AreWe are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.What We OfferWe offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.ApplicationThis is a full-time, permanent position based in Stockholm or Hudiksvall. Application deadline is 13th December 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions, feel free to contact: Johan Lindahl, Head of Product Management johan.lindahl@bjornlunden.com *For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.

title: Software Update Vehicle Type Regulation Owner
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com   Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role SummaryThis role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden. Your main tasks will be to monitor, assess, and interpret software update–related regulations and translate them into clear requirements and solutions in close collaboration with System Owners and Product Development. The role focuses on ensuring regulatory compliance across vehicle and backend systems, with key regulations including UNECE R156 and GB 44496 (China), as well as emerging global requirements, like India, South Korea and more. You will have a mix of tasks covering regulatory analysis, requirements management, compliance planning, stakeholder coordination, and governance. You will act as the main point of contact for software update regulations, supporting internal teams in understanding regulatory intent and ensuring alignment between technical solutions and legal obligations. You also represent the organization in discussions with authorities, and technical services. Job Responsibilities    Regulatory Monitoring and Analysis.     Requirements Engineering and Interpretation.     Compliance Strategy and Planning.     Cross‑functional Stakeholder Collaboration.     Interface with Authorities and External Bodies.     Risk Assessment and Compliance Reporting.     Governance, Processes, and Continuous Improvement. As a senior professional, your role will support the development of regulatory competence related to software updates, provide guidance to development and operational teams, support certification and approval activities, and collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to ensure a common understanding of regulatory expectations and compliant implementation. Who You AreYou are a highly experienced, hands-on engineer who excels at turning strategy into practical execution and delivering tangible results. You thrive in complex environments, bringing a structured and solution-oriented mindset to every challenge. With strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, you actively contribute to a positive team dynamic while guiding others. You are motivated by continuous improvement and take pride in making meaningful impact.     Experienced and hands-on: 7+ years in IT/system development; able to translate strategy into action; experience in automotive or regulatory frameworks (e.g., UNECE 156, ISO 27001, GB44496) is a plus.     Collaborative and structured mindset: Strong communicator, team player with a can-do attitude, working in a clear and organized way.     Problem-solver and motivator: Thrives in complex environments, drives improvements, and supports others while staying focused and resilient. If you consider this to be your dream job and feel that you have a fair share of what is mentioned above, please apply! We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. TRATON OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Yueming Zhao, Unit manager, yueming.zhao@scania.com We look forward to your application! title: Director Biostatistician at Asahi Kasei Therapeutics
description: About AKTXAsahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. AKTX is a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon their strong heritage of scientific innovation, AKTX aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions.The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Their business sectors, Material, Homes, and Health Care, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. AKTX is looking for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help them achieve their commitment.AKTX’s MissionPioneering innovation to continue addressing unmet medical needs, now and into the futureAKTX’s VisionPositively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the worldAKTX’s ValuesAgility, Integrity, Innovation, Expertise and AccountabilityDiversity, Equity & InclusionAt Asahi Kasei Therapeutics, they believe that diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help them better serve patients, colleagues, and communities around the world. They are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity, respect, and fairness and where all employees can contribute and succeed.AKTX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.About the position as Director BiostatisticianAs Director Biostatistician, you will be the strategic statistical lead for clinical development programs, responsible for statistical rigor, consistency and quality across all studies within each program. Partnering closely with cross-functional leaders, you will help shape development strategy and guide study designs, as well as recommend the methodologies, estimands and endpoints that best support program objectives.The role also includes overseeing statistical deliverables from internal and external partners, providing clear direction for outsourced work and acting as the escalation point for complex statistical issues. In addition, you will contribute to integrated database planning and, where applicable, the use of external and real-world data, while anticipating data needs for interim analyses, adaptive trials and regulatory interactions.The analyses you oversee will underpin regulatory strategy, publications, safety evaluations and internal decision-making. When engaging with health authorities, you will act as the statistical representative, preparing responses to their questions and attending regulatory meetings in compliance with ICH guidelines and best practices in clinical statistics. Within cross-functional teams, safety review committees and governance meetings, you will translate complex statistical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-statisticians.Key responsibilities include:    Provide strategic input into clinical development plans, target product profiles, and overall program strategy.    Advise on quantitative decision making, including go/no go criteria, dose selection, and adaptive design strategies.    Collaborate with Clinical Development to design scientifically sound and efficient clinical trials across phases (First-in-Human through registration)    Provide oversight and review of statistical sections of protocols, SAPs, and mock TLFs for individual studies.    Oversee statistical and programming activities conducted by CROs and external vendors across all studies in the program.    Work with Data Management to ensure data collection standards, CDISC compliance, and data structures are optimized for cross study analysis.    Provide clear interpretation and communication of statistical results to clinical, regulatory, and senior leadership stakeholders.    Lead statistical components of regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, CTA, BLA, MAA).    Provide mentorship and guidance to study statisticians and junior team membersAbout youYou have the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions, and you have a strong collaboration mindset with high attention to scientific and operational quality. You are comfortable with a hands-on role, stepping in as a subject matter expert where needed and you lead with clarity, integrity and accountability. You work well across functions, locations and cultures.Requirements:    MSc or PhD in Biostatistics or Statistics    Significant experience (7+ years) in clinical trial statistics within biotech/pharma.    Proven track record of leading statistical activities across multiple programs.    Strong working knowledge of regulatory guidelines (ICH, FDA, EMA) and statistical principles in drug development.    Expertise in SAS; familiarity with R is beneficial.    Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.    Ability to balance hands-on work with strategic program oversightPreferred qualifications:    Demonstrated ability to manage CROs and external statistical partners.    Experience with adaptive or innovative designs.    Exposure to early-stage development or rare/complex diseases.    Experience collaborating with Medical AffairsWhat AKTX offersMake an ImpactContribute to therapies that improve the lives of patients around the world.Build Something NewHelp shape the future of Asahi Kasei Therapeutics as they bring together expertise, people, and capabilities into one global organization.One Global TeamWork alongside colleagues across Europe, the United States, and Japan in a collaborative and inclusive environment.Grow With AKTXEnjoy opportunities for development, flexible working arrangements, and competitive local benefits.

title: Driftchef
description: Park- och trafikavdelningen har ett omfattande ansvar för allt från planering till drift av Gotlands parker, gator och kollektivtrafik. Den 1 januari 2027 införs en ny organisation för att stärka samordningen, tydliggöra ansvarsområden och skapa ett nära ledarskap i vardagen. Vårt mål är att skapa en arbetsplats där medarbetarna trivs och där vi tillsammans gör vårt yttersta för Gotlands bästa.Som en central del i detta söker vi nu en driftchef till vår driftsorganisation. Verksamheten omfattar fyra specialiserade enheter: två parkenheter, en gatuenhet samt en enhet för fordon och anläggning. Uppdraget är brett och ansvarsfullt; det innefattar drift och underhåll av kommunala anläggningar på gatu- och parkmark, yttre underhåll av kommunala fastigheter samt förvaltning av statsbidragsberättigade enskilda vägar. Direkt underställd driftchefen finns tre driftsamordnare, vars främsta uppgift är att effektivt planera och samordna driften.Verksamheten drivs i en kombination av egen regi och externa entreprenörer, där ett strategiskt fokus på effektiv planering och samordning är nyckeln till vår framgång.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom driftschef ansvarar du för planering, ledning, utveckling och uppföljning av den operativa verksamheten inom park-, gatu- och vägdrift samt renhållning i offentlig miljö. Rollen säkerställer att Gotlands offentliga miljöer är säkra, funktionella, attraktiva och väl underhållna i enlighet med lagstiftning, politiska beslut, budget och uppsatta kvalitetsmål. I rollen ingår du i avdelningens ledningsgrupp där chefer med ansvar för planeringsfunktioner ingår samt ansvarar för driftverksamhetens ledningsgrupp. Du förväntas bidra till att utveckla avdelningens verksamhet i sin helhet både kort- och långsiktigt. Samverkan mellan drift och planering är avgörande för att Gotlands offentliga miljöer ska utvecklas och förvaltas framgångsrikt och ett av driftschefens viktigaste fokusområden är att främja till och bidra i denna samverkan.Du har ansvar för personal, ekonomi och budget, arbetsmiljö och säkerställa leverans inom ansvarsområde samt följa upp verksamhetens resultat, ekonomi, kvalitet och måluppfyllelse. I rollen ansvarar du för att beslutsunderlag levereras till avdelningschef, förvaltningsledning och politisk nämnd samt företräda verksamheten i kontakter med myndigheter, organisationer, media, företag och allmänhet med flera. Rollen kräver ett tydligt, närvarande och tillitsbaserat ledarskap samt förmåga att samarbeta, att skapa förtroende hos fackliga parter, medarbetare och externa parter. I rollen kommer du att leda enhetschefer och medarbetare med varierande kompetenser och ansvarsområden. De enhetschefer du leder ansvarar i sin tur för att skapa riktning och struktur, kommunicera mål och förväntningar samt ge medarbetarna stöd och förutsättningar att ta ansvar och utvecklas i sina roller.Vem är du?Tjänsten kräver en person med relevant högskoleutbildning inom samhällsbyggnad, teknik eller anläggning, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet, samt B-körkort. Personen ska ha flera års erfarenhet av chefsroller inom drift eller entreprenad, med särskilt fokus på budgetansvar, offentlig upphandling och entreprenadstyrning. Goda kunskaper i svenska samt kunskap om lagstiftning rörande arbetsmiljö, miljö och säkerhet är ett krav.Meriterande är certifieringar som BAS-P, BAS-U och projektledarutbildning, samt erfarenhet av att leda andra chefer och arbete inom offentlig sektor. Kunskap om bland annat kommunallagen, trafikförordningen och kalkylering av driftskostnader ses också som ett plus.Som person är du en strukturerad och resultatorienterad ledare med förmåga att motivera andra och kommunicera tydligt. Du är lyhörd och samarbetsvillig i dina sociala kontakter, samtidigt som du besitter en strategisk helhetssyn och kan prioritera utifrån verksamhetens övergripande bästa.Varför välja Region Gotland? Vi är öns största arbetsgivare – med över 200 olika yrken och över 6800 medarbetare i Sveriges enda kombinerade region och kommun. Tillsammans utvecklar vi ett hållbart, tryggt och välmående Gotland för alla som bor på och besöker ön.På Gotland finns ett rikt kulturliv, storslagen natur och en kreativ entreprenörsanda. Över 61 000 personer har valt att kalla Gotland för sitt hem, året runt. Är du inte en av oss än, men nyfiken på att bli? Läs mer om livet på ön på www.gotland.com/flytta-hit Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och är stolta över våra förmåner. Läs gärna mer på www.gotland.se/formanerPå Instagramkontot @viarregiongotland kan du följa våra medarbetare och se bredden i våra olika verksamheter.Så rekryterar viVi arbetar enligt kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod och lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i enlighet med de kompetenser som beskrivs i annonsen. På så vis jobbar vi även aktivt för att motverka diskriminering. Vi är måna om säkerhet och kvalité i våra rekryteringar och du kan därför komma att omfattas av kontroller inför anställning. Om det är aktuellt får du mer information av rekryterare. ID-handling och personbevis behöver alltid uppvisas.Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver erbjudas medarbetare med företrädesrätt.
