title: Consultant – IT Architecture, Technology Strategy & Transformation
description: (Senior) Consultant – IT Architecture, Technology Strategy \& Transformation (Senior) Consultant – IT Architecture, Technology Strategy \& Transformation==============================================================================**Location:** Zurich**Work Pattern Percentage:** 80\-100%**Use your engineering background to grow into technology architecture and strategy.**As technology delivery evolves, companies increasingly need people who understand how systems are built and can connect that technical reality to strategic business decisions.At Deloitte, you will move beyond hands\-on delivery and join our Technology Strategy \& Transformation team, working with experienced architects and strategy consultants to help C\-suite executives of global organisations on some of the most complex IT projects to modernize application landscapes, define target architectures, assess platform choices and shape transformation roadmaps.This role is designed for people with a background in software development, engineering or similar technical delivery roles who want to move beyond coding to grow into architecture, technology strategy and advisory work. Your technical background will help you understand complex technology environments, challenge assumptions and advise clients on realistic architecture and transformation decisions. Deloitte will help you build your consulting, architecture and stakeholder communication toolkit needed to grow into the Technology Strategy advisory space.**How you can make an impact:*** Translate business needs into technology solutions – Work with clients and Deloitte teams to understand business challenges and help turn them into practical, well\-structured technology solutions.* Bring an engineering perspective to architecture decisions – Use your experience in software development, engineering or similar technical roles to challenge assumptions, assess feasibility and design realistic solutions.* Support solution and enterprise architecture work – Contribute to architecture documentation, application landscape assessments, solution options, target\-state designs, integration concepts and implementation roadmaps under the guidance of experienced architects.* Bridge business and technology – Help explain technical concepts, dependencies, trade\-offs and risks in a way that business and IT stakeholders can understand.* Work on technology strategy and architecture topics – Support projects involving IT strategy, enterprise architecture, application modernization, platform strategy, DevOps operating model design and large\-scale technology transformation roadmaps.* Take part in client workshops and project delivery – Support workshops, interviews, status meetings, analysis activities, documentation and presentations for technology strategy and architecture projects.* Develop your architecture and consulting toolkit – Learn how to apply architecture methods, frameworks, structured problem solving, strategic thinking and stakeholder communication to complex client environments.**Who we are looking for:*** You're genuinely curious, methodical, analytical and technically grounded. You thrive in fast\-paced settings, challenge assumptions constructively, and deliver on commitments.* You graduated in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, information systems or a comparable STEM field* You gained first professional experience (3\-5 years) in software development, software engineering, Cloud, DevOps, platform engineering or a similar technical delivery role where you developed a good understanding of the software development lifecycle and how applications, platforms, data and infrastructure interact to support processes and people.* You enjoy understanding how systems work, but you are equally interested in why technology choices matter for the business and you are motivated to move beyond hands\-on delivery into technology architecture and strategy.* You communicate confidently and clearly on technical topics to both technical and non\-technical audiences* You communicate fluently in English. or French fluency is required in addition.* Experience with solution architecture, enterprise architecture, IT transformation, stakeholder management or architecture frameworks such as TOGAF is an advantage — but not a prerequisite.**Your team**By joining the team in our Zurich office, you will be integrated into a diverse group of like\-minded colleagues right from the first day. As we take your professional development seriously, we offer you full access to our comprehensive internal and external training programme. As part of the Technology Strategy \& Transformation team you will work directly with our clients to define and execute IT Architecture and shape the way IT interacts with the business. Becoming part of our team means benefiting from our expertise, our deep understanding of technology as well as from our excellent communication skills and in\-depth business understanding. Look forward to working together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and across the world to introduce the change that will create real impact for their business.**Life at Deloitte**At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.In Switzerland, we provide industry\-specific services in the areas of Audit \& Assurance, Tax \& Legal, Strategy, Risk \& Transactions Advisory, and Technology \& Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.Join us and become part of a global network of like\-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by or improving 100 million futures by 2030\.
